pages.title: About
pages.content:
## BEAUTY WITH INTENTION.

Where artistry, expertise and personalized care come together.

Welcome to Aniekanvas Aesthetics. A beauty and aesthetics studio created with one simple belief:

Anything worth doing is worth doing well.

Founded by Stephanie “Anie,” Aniekanvas Aesthetics was built from a passion for helping women feel confident in their natural beauty while providing treatments that are thoughtful, personalized and results-focused.

From brows and permanent makeup to laser hair removal and advanced skin treatments, every service is performed with intention, precision and care.

## MORE THAN A BEAUTY STUDIO

## A PLACE TO FEEL CONFIDENT.

I want every client who walks through my door to feel comfortable asking questions, expressing their concerns and communicating exactly what they want.

There is no pressure to book a treatment simply because you came for a consultation.

Sometimes the right answer is to treat.

Sometimes it’s to wait.

Sometimes it’s to choose a different approach.

My responsibility is to give you honest guidance so you can make an informed decision about your beauty journey.

## MEET ANIE

Hi, I’m Stephanie—but most people call me Anie.

I’m the founder and artist behind Aniekanvas Aesthetics.

My journey in the beauty industry began with brows. What started as a passion grew into years of experience, education and refinement.

Today, after 7+ years in the beauty industry, I continue to build my business around the same values that have guided me from the beginning:

Dedication. Discipline. Integrity. Grace. Passion. Intention. Excellence.

I believe beauty should never be about changing who you are.

It should be about enhancing what is already there and helping you feel confident in it.

## WHAT WE SPECIALIZE IN

## OMBRÉ BROWS

Soft, dimensional, customized brows designed to enhance your natural features and simplify your everyday routine.

## LIP NEUTRALIZATION

Personalized PMU techniques designed to help create a more balanced and even-looking lip tone.

## LASER HAIR REMOVAL

Professional laser hair reduction with treatment plans customized to your skin type, hair characteristics and goals.

## COLD PLASMA

Advanced, non-invasive skin-support treatments incorporated into personalized rejuvenation and post-treatment protocols when appropriate.

## SKIN & SCAR REJUVENATION

Targeted treatments designed to support healthier-looking skin and improve the appearance of concerns such as scars and stretch marks.

## WHY ANIEKANVAS?

## BECAUSE THE DETAILS MATTER.

Choosing an aesthetic provider is personal.

You’re trusting someone with your face, your skin and your confidence.

That’s something I don’t take lightly.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics, my goal is not to sell you the most treatments.

My goal is to provide the right treatment for you.

That means honest consultations, realistic expectations, customized treatment plans and careful attention to the details that make a difference.

## MY PHILOSOPHY

## ENHANCE. DON’T ERASE.

I believe in results that still look like you.

Beautiful brows should complement your face.

Laser treatments should fit your lifestyle and goals.

Skin treatments should be approached with patience and realistic expectations.

And every treatment should be performed with care.

You don’t need to become someone else to feel beautiful.

You deserve to feel confident as yourself.

## FROM BROWS TO AESTHETICS

What began with a passion for brows has grown into a broader vision for aesthetics.

Aniekanvas Aesthetics continues to evolve through ongoing education, advanced technology and a commitment to providing high-quality services.

As the studio grows, the mission remains the same:

To help clients feel confident, cared for and proud of the skin they’re in.

## A NOTE FROM ANIE

If you’re considering booking with me, I want you to know that you don’t have to arrive knowing exactly what you need.

Bring your questions.

Bring your concerns.

Bring your inspiration photos.

Bring your goals.

We’ll figure out the right approach together.

My job isn’t simply to perform a service.

My job is to make sure you feel informed, comfortable and confident throughout the experience.

Thank you for trusting me with your beauty.

I can’t wait to welcome you into the Aniekanvas Aesthetics family.

— Anie

## READY TO BEGIN?

Your beauty journey starts here.

Explore our services and find the treatment that’s right for you.

Policies & Client Agreement

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics, we are committed to providing a professional, safe, comfortable, and elevated experience for every client.

Please read our policies carefully before booking. By booking an appointment, submitting a deposit or payment, or receiving a service, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the policies below.

These policies apply to all services, including Ombre Brows, Dark Lip Neutralization, Laser Hair Removal, Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision, Cold Plasma, packages, promotions, and other services offered by Aniekanvas Aesthetics.

## 1. APPOINTMENT BOOKING

All appointments must be booked through our official booking system or directly through Aniekanvas Aesthetics.

When booking, you are responsible for providing accurate:

Full name

Phone number

Email address

Treatment information

Medical and/or skincare information requested during intake

Please carefully review your appointment date, time, location, and service before confirming your booking.

Your appointment is not considered confirmed until the required booking payment has been received.

## 2. BOOKING FEES & DEPOSITS

A booking fee or deposit may be required to secure your appointment.

The amount required will be displayed at the time of booking or communicated before your appointment.

Unless otherwise stated:

Booking fees/deposits are applied toward the cost of your service.

Booking fees/deposits are non-refundable .

Your appointment is not held indefinitely while awaiting payment.

Failure to submit the required payment may result in your appointment being released.

By submitting your booking payment, you agree to our cancellation and rescheduling policies.

## 3. PAYMENT METHODS

We accept the payment methods displayed through our booking and payment system.

Accepted payment methods may include:

Credit card

Debit

E-transfer, where available

Approved financing/payment-plan providers such as Klarna, Affirm and Afterpay.

Other payment methods specifically offered by Aniekanvas Aesthetics

Payment options may vary by service.

All outstanding balances are due at the time of service unless an approved payment arrangement has been established in advance.

## 4. PAYMENT PLANS & FINANCING

Where available, payment plans or financing options may be offered through third-party providers.

Approval, eligibility, interest, fees, payment schedules, and financing terms are determined by the applicable provider.

Aniekanvas Aesthetics does not control third-party financing decisions or terms.

A payment plan does not change our cancellation, rescheduling, or refund policies.

## 5. PRICING

All prices listed on our website and booking platform are subject to change without notice.

The price applicable to your appointment is the price confirmed at the time of booking, unless otherwise communicated.

Prices may vary based on:

Treatment area

Treatment type

Number of sessions

Package selection

Promotional pricing

Additional services

Individual treatment requirements

Applicable taxes are added where required.

## 6. PROMOTIONAL PRICING

Promotional offers are available only during the stated promotional period and subject to the terms communicated with the promotion.

Unless otherwise stated:

Promotions cannot be combined with other offers.

Promotional pricing cannot be applied retroactively.

Promotional services must be booked according to the promotion's terms.

Promotional pricing is not transferable.

Promotional pricing cannot be exchanged for cash.

Promotional services may have specific expiry dates.

Aniekanvas Aesthetics reserves the right to end or modify promotions as permitted by applicable law.

## 7. CANCELLATIONS

We understand that plans can change. However, appointments are reserved specifically for each client.

We require at least 48 hours' notice for cancellations or appointment changes.

Cancellations made within the required notice period may be eligible to have the booking fee transferred to a future appointment, subject to our rescheduling policy.

Cancellations made with less than the required notice may result in the loss of your booking fee/deposit and 50% of the total service fee.

Repeated late cancellations may require full prepayment before future appointments can be booked.

## 8. RESCHEDULING

If you need to change your appointment, please contact us as soon as possible.

Appointments may be rescheduled with the required notice, subject to availability.

Please note:

Rescheduling is not guaranteed.

Your original appointment time is released once your appointment is changed.

A new appointment must be selected from available times.

2 Repeated rescheduling may require a new booking fee .

Last-minute rescheduling may result in the loss of your booking fee.

We recommend booking only when you are reasonably certain you can attend.

## 9. NO-SHOW POLICY

A no-show is defined as failing to attend your appointment without providing the required notice.

No-shows may result in:

Loss of the booking d deposit and 50% of the service fee.

Loss of any promotional booking benefit.

Requirement for full payment before another appointment can be scheduled.

Cancellation of future appointments in cases of repeated no-shows.

Repeated no-shows may result in refusal of future bookings.

## 10. LATE ARRIVALS

Please arrive on time for your appointment.

Your appointment time is reserved specifically for you, and arriving late may reduce the amount of time available for your service.

If you are less than 15 minutes late:

We may be able to continue with your appointment depending on the service and schedule.

If you are significantly late:

Your appointment may need to be shortened, modified, or cancelled.

If your appointment cannot be completed because of your late arrival, it may be treated as a late cancellation and your booking fee may be forfeited.

Please do not arrive excessively early without prior arrangement, as we may not be able to accommodate early arrivals.

## 11. SAME-DAY APPOINTMENT CHANGES

Same-day changes are considered on a case-by-case basis.

If we are able to accommodate a same-day change, an additional booking fee may apply.

Same-day changes are not guaranteed.

## 12. EMERGENCIES & EXCEPTIONS

We understand that genuine emergencies happen.

Emergency situations will be reviewed individually and at the discretion of Aniekanvas Aesthetics.

Examples may include:

Unexpected medical emergencies

Serious family emergencies

Significant transportation emergencies

Other circumstances outside your reasonable control

Documentation may be requested when appropriate.

An emergency exception is not guaranteed and does not automatically override the cancellation policy.

## 13. REFUND POLICY

Because our services involve time, preparation, professional expertise, consumable products, and individualized treatment planning, services are non-refundable once performed.

We do not provide refunds because a client:

Changes their mind after treatment.

Does not like the result immediately after treatment.

Expected a different result.

Experiences a normal stage of the healing process.

Decides they no longer want the treatment.

Does not complete the recommended treatment plan within the time frame.

Results vary from person to person and cannot be guaranteed.

## 14. PRODUCT & AFTERCARE PURCHASES

Aftercare products, retail products, and other items purchased from Aniekanvas Aesthetics may be final sale unless otherwise stated.

Opened or used products cannot be returned for hygiene and safety reasons.

If you believe you received a defective or incorrect product, please contact us promptly.

## 15. PACKAGES

Packages provide clients with access to multiple treatments at a package price.

Unless otherwise stated:

Package sessions must be used by the original purchaser.

Packages are non-transferable.

Packages sessions must be completed within the 12 months period.

Packages are not redeemable for cash.

Package pricing cannot be retroactively applied to previously completed appointments.

Package sessions must be used within the applicable package validity period.

Missed appointments may result in the loss of a session or booking fee, depending on the circumstances and package terms.

Specific package terms may vary and will be communicated at the time of purchase.

## 16. LASER HAIR REMOVAL PACKAGES

Laser hair removal is a progressive treatment.

Purchasing a package does not guarantee a specific percentage of hair reduction or a specific number of treatments required to achieve an individual's desired outcome.

Results vary based on factors including:

Hair colour

Hair thickness

Skin tone

Treatment area

Hair-growth cycle

Hormonal factors

Individual response

Treatment consistency

Clients must follow recommended treatment intervals and pre-care/aftercare instructions.

## 17. RESULTS & EXPECTATIONS

Individual results are not guaranteed.

This applies to:

Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision

Other aesthetic services

Results can vary because every person's skin, healing response, pigmentation, hair growth, lifestyle, and treatment history are different.

Before treatment, your practitioner will discuss realistic expectations and whether the service is appropriate for you.

## 18. OMBRE BROWS

Ombre Brows are a semi-permanent cosmetic procedure.

Immediately after treatment, brows may appear darker, bolder, warmer, or more defined than the healed result.

Healing can include temporary:

Darkening

Flaking

Peeling

Itching

Dryness

Temporary colour changes

A perfecting session may be recommended once the brows have fully healed.

The need for a perfecting session does not mean the original service was unsuccessful.

## 19. DARK LIP NEUTRALIZATION

Dark Lip Neutralization is a progressive corrective pigmentation process.

The goal is to gradually neutralize unwanted undertones and create a more balanced appearance.

Results may require multiple sessions.

Temporary colour changes, darkening, swelling, dryness, peeling, or uneven-looking colour may occur during healing.

The final healed colour cannot be guaranteed and will depend on the client's natural pigmentation and individual response.

Clients with a history of cold sores must disclose this before treatment.

## 20. INKLESS SCAR & STRETCH MARK REVISION

Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision is intended to improve the appearance of selected scars and stretch marks.

It does not guarantee complete removal.

Results develop gradually through the skin's healing and remodeling process.

Multiple treatments may be recommended depending on the age, depth, texture, colour, and characteristics of the treated area.

## 21. LASER HAIR REMOVAL

Laser hair removal is intended to provide long-term reduction in hair growth , not guaranteed permanent removal of every hair.

Multiple sessions are generally required because hair grows in different cycles.

Clients must avoid waxing, tweezing, threading, or other root-removal methods between treatments unless otherwise instructed.

## 22. COLD PLASMA

Cold Plasma treatments are customized according to the client's skin and treatment goals.

Temporary redness, warmth, sensitivity, dryness, or other temporary skin responses may occur.

Results vary and may require a series of treatments.

No specific result can be guaranteed.

## 23. CONSULTATIONS

A consultation may be required before certain treatments or may be incorporated into your appointment.

During your consultation, we may assess:

Skin condition

Treatment history

Medical information relevant to the service

Current skincare

Medications relevant to treatment

Treatment goals

Contraindications

Realistic expectations

We reserve the right to decline or postpone a treatment when we determine that proceeding may not be appropriate or safe.

## 24. HEALTH & MEDICAL DISCLOSURE

Clients are responsible for providing complete and accurate information relevant to their treatment.

Please disclose:

Relevant medical conditions

Allergies

Current medications

Prescription skincare

Recent procedures

Pregnancy or breastfeeding status where relevant to the service

History of cold sores for lip procedures

Recent tanning or sun exposure

Previous adverse reactions to aesthetic treatments

Any other information requested during your consultation or intake

Failure to disclose relevant information may affect your eligibility for treatment and your results.

Never discontinue prescribed medication solely for the purpose of receiving an aesthetic treatment without speaking with your healthcare provider.

## 25. RIGHT TO REFUSE OR POSTPONE SERVICE

Aniekanvas Aesthetics reserves the right to refuse, modify, or postpone treatment when:

A client is not an appropriate candidate.

The treatment area is compromised.

Contraindications are present.

Required information has not been disclosed.

The client is under the influence of alcohol or recreational drugs.

Continuing the treatment may create an unreasonable safety concern.

The client behaves in a threatening, abusive, discriminatory, or inappropriate manner.

In these circumstances, the appropriate outcome will be determined based on the circumstances and applicable policies.

## 26. CLIENT CONDUCT

We are committed to maintaining a respectful and professional environment.

We expect clients and staff to communicate respectfully.

Harassment, threats, discrimination, intimidation, abusive language, or inappropriate behaviour will not be tolerated.

Aniekanvas Aesthetics reserves the right to end an appointment or decline future services when necessary.

## 27. CHILDREN & GUESTS

Please attend your appointment alone whenever possible.

Because of treatment safety, space limitations, and the need for focused attention during services, children under age of 13 years are not permitted and additional guests may not be permitted unless previously approved.

If you require an accommodation, please contact us before your appointment.

## 28. PHOTOS & CLIENT RESULTS

With your permission, photographs may be taken before, during, or after treatment for:

Treatment documentation

Progress tracking

Education

Marketing

Social media

Marketing or social media use will only occur with appropriate client consent.

You may request that your images not be used for promotional purposes.

## 29. BEFORE & AFTER PHOTOS

Before-and-after photographs may be used to document your individual progress.

Please understand that photographs can look different depending on:

Lighting

Camera settings

Angle

Skin condition

Healing stage

Makeup

Time between photographs

Before-and-after images are examples of individual results and should not be interpreted as a guarantee of your own results.

## 30. GIFT CARDS

Gift cards, where offered:

Are not redeemable for cash except where required by applicable law.

Are not refundable once purchased.

May not be combined with certain promotions unless stated.

Must be presented or identified at the time of redemption.

Additional gift-card terms may apply.

## 31. E-TRANSFERS & UNPAID BALANCES

Where e-transfer is accepted, payment must be received and confirmed before an appointment is considered fully secured.

Outstanding balances must be paid before leaving the appointment unless an approved arrangement has been made.

Taxes will apply to E-transfer Payments.

Repeated unpaid balances may result in future bookings being declined.

## 32. CHARGEBACKS & PAYMENT DISPUTES

If you have a concern about a charge, please contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics directly so we can review the matter with you.

Submitting a chargeback for a valid, authorized transaction without first attempting to resolve the issue directly may result in the suspension or cancellation of future bookings, subject to applicable law.

## 33. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITY

Clients are responsible for:

Reading all pre-care and aftercare instructions.

Following treatment-specific instructions.

Disclosing relevant health and skincare information.

Arriving on time.

Attending scheduled appointments.

Completing required forms before treatment.

Following recommended treatment intervals.

Asking questions when they are unsure about instructions.

If you are unsure about anything before or after your appointment, please contact us.

## 34. POLICY UPDATES

Aniekanvas Aesthetics reserves the right to update these policies when necessary.

Updated policies will apply to future bookings and transactions after they are published.

We recommend reviewing our policies before each new treatment or booking.

## 35. AGREEMENT

By booking an appointment with Aniekanvas Aesthetics, you acknowledge that:

You have read and understood these policies.

You agree to comply with the booking, payment, cancellation, and rescheduling policies.

You understand that aesthetic treatment results vary from person to person.

You understand that results cannot be guaranteed.

You agree to follow all applicable pre-care and aftercare instructions.

You agree to provide accurate information relevant to your treatment.

You understand that Aniekanvas Aesthetics may postpone or decline treatment when necessary for safety or professional reasons.

Thank you for respecting our time, policies, and commitment to providing every client with a professional experience.

Soft. Defined. Effortlessly Beautiful.

Wake up with beautifully shaped, polished brows every day.

Ombre Brows are a semi-permanent brow enhancement technique that creates a soft, pixelated effect at the front of the brow and gradually builds into a more defined tail. The result is a natural-looking, makeup-inspired brow that enhances your features without looking harsh or overly drawn on.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , every brow is customized to complement your facial structure, skin tone, natural brow pattern, and desired look.

## YOUR BROWS, ELEVATED.

Whether you want a subtle enhancement or a more defined makeup look, your brows are designed specifically for you.

Customized brow mapping Personalized shape and color selection Semi-permanent pigment implantation Natural-looking ombre/powder effect Professional aftercare guidance

The goal? Brows that look beautiful, balanced, and effortless.

01 — Consultation & Brow Mapping

We begin by discussing your desired look, assessing your natural brows, and mapping a shape that complements your facial features.

02 — Color & Shape Selection

Your pigment and brow design are carefully selected based on your skin tone, natural coloring, existing brow hair, and desired result.

04 — Aftercare & Healing Guidance

You'll receive detailed aftercare instructions to help support proper healing and optimal results.

Ombre Brows are designed to last approximately 2–3 years , depending on factors such as skin type, lifestyle, skincare routine, sun exposure, and individual pigment retention.

## LASER HAIR REMOVAL

Smooth Skin. Less Maintenance. More Confidence.

Say goodbye to the constant cycle of shaving, waxing, and ingrown hairs.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , our laser hair removal treatments are designed to progressively reduce unwanted hair while helping you achieve smoother, more comfortable skin.

We take a personalized approach to every treatment, considering your skin tone, hair color, hair thickness, treatment area, and individual goals to create an appropriate treatment plan.

## LASER HAIR REMOVAL, CUSTOMIZED FOR YOU.

Every client and every treatment area is different.

Your treatment is customized based on factors such as:

Skin tone Hair thickness and density Hair growth pattern Treatment area Previous hair-removal methods Your individual treatment goals

Our goal is simple: progressive hair reduction with a treatment plan designed specifically for your skin and hair.

## HOW LASER HAIR REMOVAL WORKS

Laser energy is delivered to the hair follicle, where it is absorbed by pigment within the hair.

This process targets the follicle during the appropriate stage of the hair-growth cycle, helping to reduce the follicle's ability to produce hair.

Because hair grows in different cycles, multiple treatments are required to achieve optimal hair reduction.

Results vary from person to person.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

## 01 — CONSULTATION & ASSESSMENT

We review your skin tone, hair growth, treatment area, medical history, medications, and previous hair-removal methods to determine whether laser hair removal is appropriate for you.

## 02 — PREPARATION

The treatment area is prepared according to your personalized treatment protocol.

Your provider will also review any necessary precautions before treatment.

## 03 — LASER TREATMENT

The laser handpiece is applied to the treatment area using settings selected specifically for your skin and hair characteristics.

You may feel warmth, snapping, or a brief sensation during treatment. Comfort and skin response are monitored throughout your appointment.

## 04 — AFTERCARE

You'll receive personalized aftercare instructions, including what to avoid immediately following treatment and how to care for your skin between appointments.

## HOW MANY SESSIONS WILL I NEED?

Laser hair removal is a progressive treatment , not a one-time service.

Most clients require a series of treatments because the laser is most effective when hair is in the appropriate growth phase.

The number of treatments needed depends on:

Treatment area

Hair color

Hair thickness

Hormonal factors

Skin tone

Hair-growth cycle

Individual response to treatment

Your treatment plan will be adjusted based on how your hair responds throughout your series.

## BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

For best results:

Shave the treatment area as instructed before your appointment Avoid waxing, threading, tweezing, or epilating before treatment Avoid tanning and intentional sun exposure Do not arrive with irritated, sunburned, or compromised skin Follow any personalized instructions provided during your consultation

Do not wax or tweeze the hair immediately before laser treatment , as the follicle needs to remain present for the laser to target it.

## AFTER YOUR APPOINTMENT

Your skin may appear slightly red or feel warm immediately following treatment. This can be a normal temporary response.

After treatment:

Avoid excessive heat for the recommended period Avoid picking, scratching, or irritating the treated area Protect treated skin from sun exposure Apply sunscreen as recommendedFollow your personalized aftercare instructions

Hair may continue to shed from treated follicles over the following days or weeks.

## DARK LIP NEUTRALIZATION

Restore. Balance. Enhance.

Beautiful lips don't have to mean one specific shade.

Dark Lip Neutralization is a specialized cosmetic tattooing technique designed to help improve the appearance of darker, cool-toned, uneven, or hyperpigmented lips by introducing carefully selected corrective pigments.

The goal is to gradually neutralize unwanted darkness and create a more balanced, brighter-looking lip tone while maintaining a natural appearance.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , every lip is assessed individually. Your natural lip color, undertone, level of pigmentation, and desired result all influence the treatment approach.

## YOUR NATURAL LIPS, ENHANCED.

Dark Lip Neutralization is not about making every client's lips the same color .

It's about working with your natural lip tone and gradually creating a more even, balanced appearance.

Customized color correction Designed for uneven lip pigmentation Helps neutralize cool, grey, purple, or brown tones Gradual, customized treatment approach Natural-looking results

Your lips are unique, and your treatment should be too.

## HOW DARK LIP NEUTRALIZATION WORKS

Specialized corrective pigments are carefully selected based on the underlying tone of your lips.

The pigment is implanted into the lips using a cosmetic tattooing technique. Depending on the degree and type of pigmentation, multiple sessions may be necessary .

The first appointment may focus primarily on neutralizing the underlying darkness rather than immediately achieving your desired final lip color.

As the lips heal and the color develops, future sessions can be used to further refine the tone.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

## 01 — CONSULTATION & COLOUR ASSESSMENT

We assess your natural lip color, undertones, pigmentation pattern, previous cosmetic tattooing, and desired outcome.

## 02 — LIP MAPPING & PREPARATION

Corrective pigment is carefully implanted into the lips to begin addressing unwanted dark or uneven tones.

## 04 — HEALING & ASSESSMENT

Your lips will go through a healing and color-development process.

Once healed, we assess the result and determine whether additional neutralization or a future color-enhancement session is appropriate.

## HOW MANY SESSIONS WILL I NEED?

One session does not guarantee a final result, minimum of 2 sessions is required.

The number of sessions varies depending on:

The depth and intensity of pigmentation

Natural lip undertone

Skin tone

Previous lip tattooing

Lifestyle factors

Individual healing and pigment retention

How your lips respond to the corrective pigment

Some clients may require multiple sessions to gradually achieve their desired level of neutralization.

Your treatment plan will be determined based on your individual lips.

## HEALING & COLOUR CHANGES

Your lips will appear significantly different throughout the healing process.

Immediately after treatment, the color may appear brighter, darker, or more intense than the healed result.

As your lips heal, the color will soften and settle.

Temporary dryness, tenderness, swelling, flaking, or peeling can occur.

If your lip pigmentation is new, changing, unexplained, painful, or associated with other symptoms, please seek appropriate medical evaluation before booking.

## INKLESS SCAR & STRETCH MARK REVISION

Smooth. Renew. Restore Your Confidence.

Your skin tells your story — but you don't have to feel defined by every mark.

Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision is a cosmetic skin-revision treatment designed to improve the appearance, texture, and overall tone of scars and stretch marks without using tattoo ink or camouflage pigment.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , each treatment is customized according to the appearance, age, texture, location, and condition of the area being treated.

The goal is not to erase your skin's history. It's to help create a smoother, more even-looking appearance over time.

## WHAT IS INKLESS SCAR & STRETCH MARK REVISION?

Unlike traditional scar camouflage, this treatment does not use pigment or tattoo ink to cover the area .

Instead, a specialized cosmetic revision technique is used to work with the appearance of the affected skin and support a more even-looking result as the area heals.

It may be used for the appearance of:

Stretch marks Surgical scars Certain healed injury scars Post-procedure scars Uneven-looking scar tissue Changes in skin texture associated with healed marks

## BOOK CONSULTATION

## DPN & SKIN TAG REMOVAL

Clearer-Looking Skin. Precision Treatment. Confidence in Your Skin.

Small skin growths can be frustrating, especially when they appear on visible areas such as the face and neck.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , our DPN & Skin Tag Removal service is designed to safely and precisely address suitable benign-appearing skin tags and DPNs , helping create a smoother, more even-looking appearance.

Every client and every growth is different, which is why we begin with an assessment before treatment.

WHAT ARE DPNs & SKIN TAGS?

DPN — Dermatosis Papulosa Nigra

DPNs are small, usually dark brown to black, raised skin growths that commonly appear on the face, particularly around the cheeks, temples and forehead. They are especially common in deeper skin tones.

## SKIN TAGS

Skin tags are small, soft, benign-appearing growths that can develop on areas such as the neck, underarms, eyelids and other areas where skin experiences friction.

Although DPNs and skin tags are generally benign, not every skin growth should be cosmetically treated .

Any growth that looks unusual, changes, bleeds, becomes painful, or has not been previously assessed should be evaluated by a qualified medical professional before cosmetic treatment.

## WHAT CAN WE TREAT?

Our DPN & Skin Tag Removal service may be suitable for:

Suitable DPNs Small benign-appearing skin tags Certain small raised cosmetic skin imperfections

## COMMON TREATMENT AREAS

Depending on suitability, treatment may be performed on areas such as:

• Face • Neck • Underarms • Chest • Back • Other suitable areas

Certain areas, including very close to the eyes or other sensitive locations, may require additional assessment or may not be suitable for treatment.

## WHAT TECHNIQUE IS USED?

Precision Cauterization

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics , suitable DPNs and skin tags may be treated using a cauterization technique . Cauterization uses controlled thermal energy to precisely treat targeted tissue.

Before treatment, each growth is assessed to determine whether it is appropriate for cosmetic treatment.

## BENEFITS OF CAUTERIZATION

Minimally Invasive

Cauterization is a targeted cosmetic technique that does not require traditional surgical excision. Treatment is performed directly on the selected growth, with healing taking place naturally afterward.

Precision-Focused Treatment

Controlled thermal energy allows us to target individual growths with precision, helping minimize unnecessary treatment to the surrounding skin.

Focused Cosmetic Treatment

Because the treatment is concentrated on the selected growth, we can address individual areas without treating large sections of surrounding skin.

Convenient Treatment

Depending on the number, size and location of the growths, multiple suitable growths may be treated during the same appointment , making the process convenient for clients with several areas they would like addressed.

Customized to Your Skin

Every treatment is adjusted according to the individual growth, treatment area and your skin's characteristics. This is particularly important when treating melanin-rich skin , which may be more susceptible to temporary pigmentation changes following skin trauma.

One Appointment May Be Enough

For many small, suitable growths, treatment may be completed during one appointment . However, additional treatment or a follow-up assessment may be recommended depending on how the area heals and how the skin responds.

Results and healing vary from person to person. No specific number of sessions or outcome can be guaranteed.

## YOUR TREATMENT EXPERIENCE

## 01 — CONSULTATION & ASSESSMENT

Before treatment, we assess the area and the individual growths you would like addressed.

We look at factors such as:

• Size • Shape • Colour • Location • Number of growths • Skin type • Previous skin reactions or scarring

This allows us to determine whether cosmetic treatment is appropriate.

If a growth appears suspicious or outside the scope of cosmetic treatment, we will not treat it and may recommend medical assessment.

## 02 — SKIN PREPARATION

The treatment area is thoroughly cleansed and prepared before the procedure.

For suitable clients, a topical numbing product may be used to improve comfort during treatment.

## 03 — PRECISION REMOVAL

A specialized cosmetic removal technique is used to precisely target the selected growth while minimizing unnecessary trauma to the surrounding skin.

Treatment is performed carefully and individually rather than rushing through multiple growths.

## 04 — POST-TREATMENT CARE

After treatment, the area may appear red, slightly swollen, darker than usual, or develop a small crust/scab as the skin begins to heal.

You'll receive detailed aftercare instructions to help support proper healing and reduce unnecessary irritation or pigment changes.

## WHY CLIENTS CHOOSE DPN & SKIN TAG REMOVAL

Targeted treatment Precision-focused approach Suitable for many areas of the body Customized to your skin type Minimal treatment area No pigment or tattoo camouflage involved Designed to improve the appearance of unwanted growths

Because every person's skin heals differently, results and healing times vary.

## WILL THE GROWTHS COME BACK?

The treated growth itself may be successfully removed, but new DPNs or skin tags can develop in the future .

Factors such as genetics, age, hormones and repeated friction can contribute to developing new growths.

Removing existing growths does not prevent new ones from forming.

## HOW MANY TREATMENTS WILL I NEED?

For many suitable, small growths, treatment may be completed in one appointment .

However, the number of appointments required depends on:

• Number of growths • Size and location • Type of growth • Skin response • Healing • Treatment area

Some areas may require a follow-up assessment after healing.

Your treatment plan will be determined during your consultation.

## HOW LONG DOES THE APPOINTMENT TAKE?

Treatment time varies significantly from client to client.

The appointment may include:

Consultation → Preparation → Numbing → Precision Treatment → Aftercare

The number and size of growths being treated will affect the overall appointment time.

For larger treatment areas or multiple growths, additional time may be required.

Your appointment time is an estimate and does not necessarily represent the amount of time spent actively treating each growth.

## IS IT PAINFUL?

Most clients describe the treatment as manageable.

A topical numbing product may be used when appropriate to help minimize discomfort.

You may still feel some pressure, warmth, tingling or brief sensitivity during treatment.

Individual pain tolerance varies.

## WHAT SHOULD I EXPECT AFTER TREATMENT?

Immediately after treatment, you may experience:

• Redness • Mild swelling • Warmth or sensitivity • Darkening of the treated area • Small crusts or scabs • Temporary skin discoloration

These are possible parts of the normal healing response.

Do not pick, scratch or prematurely remove any scabbing.

Allow the skin to heal naturally and follow your personalized aftercare instructions.

## WHEN WILL I SEE RESULTS?

You may notice a visible difference immediately after treatment; however, the treated area is not considered fully healed immediately .

The skin needs time to repair itself.

As healing progresses, treated areas may change in colour and appearance before settling.

The final appearance can take several weeks to become clear, depending on the area treated and your individual healing response.

## DPN & SKIN TAG REMOVAL PRICING

## YOUR TREATMENT IS CUSTOMIZED

Pricing is based on the number, size, location and complexity of the growths being treated , rather than simply the amount of time spent in the treatment room.

Because every client has a different number and distribution of growths, a consultation is required before a final quote can be provided.

## VIRTUAL CONSULTATION

For a virtual assessment, clear photographs may be requested.

Please provide:

• Well-lit photos • No makeup over the treatment area • No filters • Clear, focused images • Multiple angles of each treatment area

Photos should accurately represent the growths you would like assessed.

Final suitability and pricing may change if the appearance of the area differs from the photographs provided.

## IMPORTANT: NOT EVERY GROWTH CAN BE REMOVED

Your safety comes first.

We do not diagnose skin growths and cosmetic treatment should not be used to determine whether a growth is cancerous or medically concerning.

We will not cosmetically treat a growth that appears suspicious or requires medical evaluation.

Please see a qualified healthcare professional before booking if a growth:

• Is new and unexplained • Changes in size, shape or colour • Bleeds without an obvious cause • Is painful, itchy or persistently irritated • Has an irregular appearance • Develops a sore or ulceration • Looks significantly different from your other growths

When in doubt, have it medically assessed first.

## CONTRAINDICATIONS & WHEN WE MAY POSTPONE TREATMENT

Treatment may need to be postponed or declined if you have:

• Active infection in the treatment area • Open wounds or broken skin • Active rash or significant irritation • Significant inflammation • Recent sunburn • A history of problematic or excessive scarring • Certain medications or medical conditions that may affect healing • An undiagnosed or suspicious skin growth

Please disclose all relevant medical conditions, allergies and medications during your consultation.

Never stop a prescribed medication solely for a cosmetic procedure without speaking with your prescribing healthcare professional.

If you're ready to address unwanted DPNs or suitable skin tags, let's start with an assessment.

Your skin is unique, and your treatment should be too.

Active, severe or worsening inflammation should be assessed by a qualified medical professional before cosmetic treatment.

Treatment may be postponed or declined if contraindications are present.

items.question: Am I a good candidate for permanent makeup?
items.answer:
You may not be a good candidate for permanent makeup if…

Permanent makeup is a tattoo and creates an open wound in the skin. Certain medical conditions, medications, skin conditions and treatments can affect bleeding, healing or your risk of complications. Please disclose all medical conditions and medications on your medical forms. When necessary, we may require medical clearance before proceeding.

Please DO NOT book if:

You are pregnant or breastfeeding. As a studio policy, we require clients to wait 6 months after they have finished breastfeeding.

You have a history of keloid scarring.

You are currently sick with a cold, flu, viral infection or other active illness. Please rest and reschedule!

You currently have a sunburn, significant tan, rash, infection, irritation or compromised skin in the treatment area.

You have uncontrolled high blood pressure.

Please contact us BEFORE booking if any of the following apply to you:

Diabetes

Autoimmune disease or a condition/medication that affects your immune system

Recent chemotherapy, radiation or other cancer treatment

Hepatitis B or C

Epilepsy

Pacemaker or other implanted medical device

Heart condition

Blood-thinning or anticoagulant medication

History of hypertrophic scarring

Psoriasis, dermatitis, eczema, vitiligo, keratosis pilaris, chronic acne, rosacea, broken capillaries or another skin condition affecting or surrounding the brow area

Current or recent isotretinoin (Accutane) use

Prescription retinoids, retinol, AHAs or other active/exfoliating skincare products

Any other medical condition, medication or treatment that may affect your skin, bleeding, immune system or ability to heal

You have EVER had microblading or permanent makeup performed by another artist — even if it has faded or undergone tattoo removal.

Some of the above may simply require an adjustment to timing or skincare, while others may require written clearance from your treating healthcare professional before we can safely proceed.

Never discontinue or alter a prescribed medication for a permanent makeup appointment unless your prescribing healthcare professional has specifically instructed you to do so.

If you’re unsure whether something applies to you, please contact us at Aniekanvas@gmail.com or 647-901-8817 before booking . We would always rather review your individual circumstances first and make sure permanent makeup is appropriate for you.

items.question: What are Ombré Brows?
items.answer:
Ombré brows are a form of semi-permanent makeup where pigment is implanted into the skin to create a soft, shaded brow effect.

Unlike traditional tattooed brows, ombré brows are designed with a gradient: lighter and softer toward the front of the brow and more defined toward the arch and tail.

The finished result can range from very natural and soft to more defined and makeup-like, depending on your preferences.

items.question: How long does the appointment take?
items.answer:
Your initial ombré brow appointment takes approximately 2.5 hours.

This includes consultation, brow mapping and design, preparation, numbing, pigment selection and the actual procedure.

I do not rush the mapping process. Your brow shape is an important part of the final result, so we take the time to make sure the shape is balanced and suited to your facial features before beginning.

items.question: Is the procedure painful?
items.answer:
Everyone experiences the procedure differently, but most clients describe the sensation as mild discomfort rather than significant pain.

A topical numbing product is used to help make the appointment as comfortable as possible.

You may feel some pressure, vibration or scratching sensations during the procedure. Sensitivity can vary depending on your individual pain tolerance, skin condition and menstrual cycle.

items.question: How long do Ombré Brows last?
items.answer:
Ombré brows are considered semi-permanent and generally last approximately 2–3 years, although longevity varies from person to person.

Factors that can affect retention include:

● Skin type

● Oil production

● Sun exposure

● Skincare products

● Exfoliation

● Lifestyle

● Medications and individual skin characteristics

● How well aftercare instructions are followed

Your brows will gradually soften and fade over time rather than disappearing all at once.

items.question: Will my brows look dark after the appointment?
items.answer:
Yes. Immediately after the procedure, your brows will typically appear darker and more defined than the healed result.

This is completely normal.

As the skin heals, the pigment will soften and the colour will gradually settle. The healed result is significantly softer than what you see immediately after the appointment.

Do not judge your final colour during the first few days of healing.

items.question: What is the healing process like?
items.answer:
Please see “What to expect after my appointment/aftercare”

Healing generally takes up to 6 weeks.

The first 7-14 days is the physical healing.

During the first few days, your brows may appear darker, slightly swollen or more defined than expected. As the skin continues to heal, the brows may become flaky and appear temporarily lighter or patchy.

This can be part of the normal healing process.

Your brows will continue to settle and develop their final appearance as the skin fully heals.

Important: Do not pick, scratch or peel the brows during healing.

items.question: What is the pre-care information for Ombre Brows?
items.answer: Please see “Important Precare Section” and should be read prior to booking an appointment to ensure everything can be followed.

items.question: Will my brows peel?
items.answer:
They may.

Some clients experience visible flaking or peeling while others experience very little. Everyone heals differently.

Allow the skin to naturally shed. Picking or pulling at the skin can interfere with pigment retention and may increase the risk of irritation or scarring.

items.question: When will I see my final results?
items.answer:
Your brows will continue changing throughout the healing process.

The colour may initially appear very dark, then become significantly lighter before gradually settling.

The final healed result is typically assessed after the skin has had adequate time to recover.

This is also why a 6–8 week touch-up, when recommended, is important.

items.question: Do I need a touch-up?
items.answer:
A touch-up may be recommended depending on how your brows heal and retain pigment.

The first touch-up is generally scheduled around 6–8 weeks after the initial procedure, once the skin has fully healed enough to properly assess the result.

The purpose of the touch-up is not to completely redo your brows. It allows us to refine areas where pigment may have healed lighter, strengthen certain areas and make small adjustments where appropriate.

items.question: Is the 6–8 week touch-up included?
items.answer:
The initial ombré brow service and the 6–8 week touch-up are priced separately.

Initial Ombré Brows: $500+ tax

6–8 Week Touch-Up: $120 + tax

A touch-up is recommended when needed based on your healed results.

items.question: Can you make my brows very natural?
items.answer:
Absolutely.

Ombré brows do not have to look heavy or overly makeup-like.

The intensity can be customized based on your existing brows, skin, personal preference and desired outcome.

If you prefer a softer, more natural appearance, communicate this during your consultation so your desired look can be taken into consideration during the design process.

items.question: Can you make my brows very bold?
items.answer:
Yes, within the limits of what is appropriate for your skin and desired long-term result.

The beauty of ombré brows is that the saturation and intensity can be customized.

However, I will always prioritize a result that is appropriate for your features and skin rather than simply making the brows as dark as possible.

items.question: Will you choose the brow shape for me?
items.answer:
Your brows are designed collaboratively.

I will assess your facial structure, natural brow pattern and existing asymmetries before creating the proposed shape.

The brows are mapped before pigment is implanted, and you will have an opportunity to review the shape.

The goal is to create brows that complement your face—not simply follow a trend.

items.question: Are my brows going to be perfectly symmetrical?
items.answer:
Brows are sisters, not identical twins.

Natural facial asymmetry is extremely common. Bone structure, muscle movement and the natural growth pattern of your brows can all contribute to differences between the two sides.

The goal is balanced and flattering brows, not artificial mathematical symmetry.

items.question: Can I get Ombré Brows if I have little or no natural brow hair?
items.answer:
In many cases, yes.

Ombré brows can be particularly helpful for clients with sparse brows, over-plucked brows or areas with little natural hair.

However, suitability depends on your skin, previous procedures and overall brow condition.

items.question: Can I get Ombré Brows if I have oily skin?
items.answer:
Yes, but oily skin can affect how pigment heals and retains.

Clients with oilier skin may experience softer or less crisp healed results and may require different expectations regarding longevity and touch-ups.

During your consultation, your skin characteristics will be assessed so we can determine the most appropriate approach.

items.question: Can I get Ombré Brows if I have sensitive skin?
items.answer:
Sensitivity does not automatically mean you cannot receive the service.

However, your skin needs to be in an appropriate condition for the procedure.

If your skin is currently irritated, compromised, sunburned, actively inflamed or experiencing another condition around the brow area, your appointment may need to be postponed.

items.question: Can I get Ombré Brows if I already have permanent makeup?
items.answer:
Not automatically.

Existing brow work must be assessed before booking.

If you have previous microblading, powder brows, ombré brows, nano brows or another form of permanent makeup, please send clear photos of your brows before booking.

If the existing pigment is too dark, saturated, discoloured or significantly outside the desired shape, a new procedure may not be appropriate.

In some cases, removal or lightening may be recommended before new work can be performed.

Please do not book a new brow procedure without disclosing previous work.

items.question: Can you cover old Microblading?
items.answer:
Sometimes, but it depends entirely on the condition of the existing pigment.

If the old work is sufficiently faded and there is enough room to create the desired shape, a new treatment may be possible.

If the previous pigment is too saturated, dark, grey, red, orange or outside the desired shape, attempting to cover it may create an undesirable result.

A photo assessment is required before determining whether you are a suitable candidate.

items.question: Can I get Ombré Brows while pregnant or breastfeeding?
items.answer:
For safety and policy reasons, appointments may need to be postponed during pregnancy and certain stages of breastfeeding.

If you are pregnant, recently postpartum or breastfeeding, please contact the studio before booking so your individual circumstances can be reviewed.

items.question: Can I wear makeup to my appointment?
items.answer:
Yes, but arriving with clean skin around the brow area is preferred.

If you have a specific brow shape you normally create with makeup, you may bring a photo or reference so we can understand your preferences.

items.question: Will Ombré Brows damage my natural eyebrow hair?
items.answer:
The procedure is performed on the skin rather than removing your natural eyebrow hair\.

Your natural brow hairs can continue to grow normally\.

During the appointment, unnecessary hair removal is avoided whenever possible so your natural brow structure can be preserved\.

items.question: Can I still tweeze or wax my brows after getting Ombré Brows?
items.answer:
Yes, once the brows have completely healed.

However, I recommend maintaining the shape carefully and avoiding unnecessary removal of natural brow hairs.

If you are unsure where to clean up your brows, professional brow maintenance is recommended.

items.question: Can Ombré Brows be removed?
items.answer:
Yes, but removal is not always simple and should never be treated as an easy reversal.

Depending on the pigment, depth, age of the work and your skin, removal or lightening may require specialized treatments and multiple sessions.

This is why choosing an experienced artist and an appropriate brow design is so important.

items.question: What is laser hair removal?
items.answer:
Laser hair removal uses concentrated light energy that is absorbed by pigment in the hair. The energy is converted into heat and targets the hair follicle, reducing its ability to produce hair.

Because hair follicles grow through different stages, multiple treatments are required to target hairs during the appropriate growth phase.

The goal is long-term hair reduction , not a guarantee that every hair will permanently disappear.

items.question: Is laser hair removal permanent?
items.answer:
Laser hair removal can provide significant and long-lasting hair reduction, but results vary.

Some treated follicles may stop producing hair, while others may eventually produce finer or lighter hair.

Hormonal changes can also cause new hair growth, particularly on areas such as the face.

Maintenance treatments may be recommended depending on your individual response.

items.question: What makes Aniekanvas Aesthetics different?
items.answer:
YOUR SKIN IS NOT AN AFTERTHOUGHT.

We don't believe in using the same settings on every client.

Your skin tone, hair characteristics and treatment area matter.

Our approach prioritizes:

PERSONALIZED ASSESSMENT Your skin and hair are assessed before treatment.

SKIN-TONE CONSIDERATION Treatment parameters are selected with your individual skin characteristics in mind.

REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS We focus on long-term reduction rather than promising unrealistic results.

ONGOING ASSESSMENT Your treatment plan can be adjusted based on how your skin and hair respond.

items.question: Does laser hair removal work on darker skin?
items.answer:
The wavelength matters.

Darker skin contains more melanin, which means the laser must be able to effectively target the pigment in the hair while minimizing unnecessary absorption by the surrounding skin.

Our laser technology uses Nd 1064 nm wavelength technology , which has a longer wavelength and penetrates deeper into the skin than shorter wavelengths.

The 1064 nm wavelength has relatively lower absorption by melanin in the epidermis, making it a commonly used wavelength for treating hair in darker skin types when appropriate treatment parameters are selected .

This is particularly important for clients with Fitzpatrick skin types IV–VI, where managing the interaction between the laser and melanin in the skin is critical.

But wavelength is only part of the equation.

Having a 1064 nm wavelength does not automatically make a treatment risk-free.

Safe and effective treatment also depends on:

Your individual skin tone

Recent sun exposure or tanning

Hair colour and thickness

Treatment area

Energy settings

Pulse duration

Spot size

Cooling

Treatment technique

Your individual response to treatment

That's why we don't use a “one setting fits everyone” approach.

Your skin and hair are assessed before treatment, and treatment parameters are selected accordingly.

items.question: Why Nd 1064 nm?
items.answer:
The 1064 nm Nd wavelength is widely used when treating darker skin because its longer wavelength can penetrate deeper while having less absorption by epidermal melanin compared with shorter wavelengths.

This can provide a more suitable treatment option for clients with higher levels of melanin in their skin.

Our goal is not simply to use the highest possible energy.

Our goal is to use the appropriate wavelength and parameters for YOUR skin and hair.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer:
Most clients require a series of treatments rather than a single session.

The exact number varies depending on:

Treatment area

Hair color

Hair thickness

Skin tone

Hair-growth cycle

Hormonal factors

Individual response to treatment

We assess your progress throughout your treatment series and adjust your treatment plan when appropriate.

items.question: What Results Should I Expect?
items.answer:
The goal is progressive hair reduction .

You may notice:

Slower hair growth

Fewer hairs

Finer hairs

Less frequent shaving

Reduced appearance of razor bumps or ingrown hairs

Results vary.

No responsible provider should guarantee that every hair will permanently disappear.

Health Canada specifically notes that multiple treatments are generally required and that results are not guaranteed for every person or treatment area.

items.question: How often should I get laser hair removal?
items.answer:
Treatment intervals depend on the area being treated and your hair-growth cycle.

Laser works best when targeted hairs are in an appropriate growth phase, so treating too frequently does not necessarily mean faster results.

Your recommended treatment interval will be provided based on your treatment area and individual response.

Ideally 6-8 weeks for the first 5 sessions.

items.question: Is Nd 1064 nm safe for Black and brown skin?
items.answer:
Nd 1064 nm is commonly used for laser treatments involving darker skin tones, but no laser wavelength is risk-free .

Darker skin can still experience complications such as burns or temporary or persistent changes in pigmentation if treatment parameters are inappropriate.

This is why proper assessment, conservative parameter selection, cooling, technique and appropriate aftercare are essential.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics, your skin tone and treatment area are assessed before treatment so we can determine whether the treatment is appropriate for you.

items.question: Does the 1064 nm wavelength guarantee that I won't get burns or hyperpigmentation?
items.answer:
No.

This is an important distinction.

The Nd 1064 nm wavelength can be a valuable option for darker skin, but it does not eliminate the possibility of adverse reactions.

Laser treatment can still cause burns or temporary or persistent pigmentation changes if the skin receives inappropriate treatment.

Your safety depends on the entire treatment protocol , not simply the wavelength.

That's why we assess your skin before every treatment and may adjust, postpone or decline treatment when conditions are not appropriate.

items.question: Why is this important for darker skin?
items.answer:
Melanin is naturally present in darker skin.

Because laser energy can interact with melanin, treating darker skin requires careful consideration of how much energy reaches the surrounding epidermis versus the hair follicle.

The 1064 nm Nd wavelength has properties that can make it particularly useful for darker skin, but proper settings and technique remain essential .

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics, we believe darker skin should not mean lower-quality treatment.

It means thoughtful treatment, appropriate technology and careful technique.

YOUR SKIN DESERVES A CUSTOM APPROACH.

The goal isn't simply to remove hair.

The goal is to reduce hair while respecting your skin.

items.question: Is laser hair removal completely painless?
items.answer:
No treatment should be advertised as completely painless for every client.

You may feel cold pinching or tingling or brief discomfort during treatment.

Our goal is to make treatment as comfortable as possible while maintaining appropriate treatment parameters for your skin and hair.

items.question: How long does a laser appointment take?
items.answer:
Treatment time depends on the area being treated.

Small areas such as the upper lip or chin can be completed relatively quickly, while larger areas such as full legs or full body require significantly more time.

Your booking confirmation will indicate the expected appointment duration

items.question: Do I need to shave before my appointment?
items.answer:
Yes, shaving is generally preferred before treatment.

Your specific shaving instructions will depend on the treatment area.

Shaving leaves the hair shaft short while keeping the follicle intact, allowing the laser energy to target the hair follicle without unnecessary hair above the skin.

items.question: Can I wax or tweeze before laser?
items.answer:
No.

Avoid waxing, tweezing, threading or epilating the treatment area before your laser session unless specifically instructed otherwise.

These methods remove the hair from the follicle, which is the structure the laser needs to target.

Shaving is generally preferred between treatments.

Health Canada's laser hair-removal safety guidance specifically recommends avoiding plucking, waxing and electrolysis before treatment.

items.question: Can I shave between laser treatments?
items.answer:
Yes.

Shaving is generally the preferred method of hair removal between laser sessions because it does not remove the hair from the follicle.

Avoid waxing, tweezing and epilating unless instructed otherwise.

items.question: Can I use depilatory cream?
items.answer:
Ask before using depilatory creams on an area that is being treated.

Some products can irritate or sensitize the skin, which may make the area unsuitable for treatment.

items.question: Can I get laser if I am tanned?
items.answer:
No—recent tanning can increase risk.

A tan increases melanin in the skin and can change how the laser interacts with the treatment area.

This can increase the risk of unwanted skin reactions and may require treatment to be postponed.

Avoid intentional tanning and follow your pre-care instructions regarding sun exposure.

items.question: Can I use self-tanner before laser?
items.answer:
Avoid self-tanner on the treatment area before your appointment.

Your skin should be in its natural, untanned state so the treatment parameters can be assessed appropriately.

The American Academy of Dermatology also recommends avoiding sunless tanners before laser hair removal.

items.question: What happens during my first appointment?
items.answer:
Your first appointment includes an assessment of the treatment area.

We consider:

Skin tone

Recent sun exposure or tanning

Hair colour

Hair thickness

Hair density

Treatment area

Previous hair-removal methods

Relevant medications or medical history

Your goals and expectations

A patch test may be recommended before proceeding with a full treatment, particularly when appropriate for your skin and treatment protocol.

items.question: Why is a consultation important?
items.answer:
Consultation is done before your laser appointment.

Laser hair removal is not simply about choosing a machine and turning up the power.

The device, wavelength, settings, pulse duration, cooling, skin tone, hair characteristics and operator technique all influence both results and risk.

Your consultation allows us to determine whether laser is appropriate and how your treatment should be approached.

items.question: What should my skin look like immediately after treatment?
items.answer:
It is common to experience temporary:

Redness

Warmth

Mild swelling around hair follicles

Sensitivity

These effects generally settle with time.

However, significant pain, blistering, burns or other concerning changes are not something you should simply ignore .

Laser treatments can cause burns, blistering, infection and temporary or permanent pigment changes when complications occur.

If you experience concerning symptoms, contact the studio and seek appropriate medical assessment.

items.question: Will the hair disappear immediately?
items.answer:
Not necessarily.

Treated hairs can remain visible after the appointment and may gradually shed over the following days or weeks.

Do not assume that visible hair immediately after treatment means the laser did not work.

items.question: Why do I still see hair after my treatment?
items.answer:
Laser targets hairs during specific stages of the growth cycle.

Not every follicle is actively growing at the same time.

This is one of the main reasons a series of treatments is necessary.

You may also notice hair growth between treatments because different follicles are entering their growth phase at different times.

items.question: When will I start seeing results?
items.answer:
Some clients notice changes after their first treatment, such as slower growth, reduced density or finer hair.

However, meaningful results generally develop over a series of treatments.

Your results will depend on your individual hair-growth cycle, hair characteristics, skin tone and treatment parameters.

items.question: Can laser make my hair grow back thicker?
items.answer:
Laser is intended to reduce hair growth, not stimulate it.

However, rare cases of paradoxical hair growth have been reported, particularly in certain facial areas and hormonal contexts.

If you notice unexpected changes in hair growth, let us know so the treatment plan can be reassessed.

items.question: Can laser cause darker or lighter skin?
items.answer:
Yes.

Temporary or, less commonly, longer-lasting changes in skin pigmentation can occur after laser treatment.

This is particularly important to consider when treating darker skin tones.

Appropriate treatment parameters, skin assessment, sun avoidance and aftercare are important for reducing risk.

items.question: Can I get laser over tattoos?
items.answer:
Laser hair removal should not be performed directly over tattoos unless specifically determined safe under the applicable device instructions and treatment protocol.

The laser can interact with tattoo pigment and potentially cause injury or alter the tattoo.

Always disclose tattoos in or near the treatment area before your appointment.

items.question: Can I get laser if I have a skin condition?
items.answer:
It depends on the condition and whether it affects the treatment area.

Active irritation, infection, open wounds or significant inflammation may require postponement.

Please disclose any relevant skin conditions during your consultation.

If you're unsure whether a medical skin condition is suitable for treatment, medical clearance may be required

items.question: Can I get laser while pregnant?
items.answer:
Laser hair removal is generally postponed during pregnancy as a precaution.

If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant, please contact the studio before booking.

items.question: Can I get laser while breastfeeding?
items.answer:
Please disclose that you are breastfeeding before booking.

Your individual circumstances and treatment area will be assessed, and treatment may be postponed depending on the situation.

items.question: What medications should I disclose?
items.answer:
Please disclose all medications, supplements and topical products you use.

Certain medications can increase photosensitivity or otherwise affect how your skin responds to laser treatment.

The American Academy of Dermatology specifically recommends telling the provider about medications, including aspirin and isotretinoin, before laser hair removal.

Never stop a prescribed medication simply because you are having laser treatment.

If there is a concern about a medication, speak with your healthcare provider.

items.question: Can I use retinol or exfoliating products?
items.answer:
Depending on the treatment area and product, you may be instructed to temporarily pause certain active skincare ingredients.

These can include retinoids and exfoliating acids.

You will receive specific pre-care instructions based on the area being treated.

items.question: Can I exercise after laser?
items.answer:
Follow the aftercare instructions provided for your specific treatment.

If your skin is warm, red or sensitive after treatment, avoid activities that significantly increase heat, friction or sweating until the skin has settled.

items.question: Can I shower after laser?
items.answer:
Gentle showering is generally acceptable, but avoid very hot water and aggressive scrubbing immediately after treatment.

Pat the treated area dry rather than rubbing it.

Follow the individualized aftercare instructions provided at your appointment.

items.question: Can I swim after laser?
items.answer:
Avoid swimming until the treated skin has settled and there is no significant irritation.

This includes pools, hot tubs and other bodies of water.

Your aftercare instructions will provide the appropriate timeframe for your treatment.

items.question: Can I go in the sun after laser?
items.answer:
Sun protection is extremely important.

Avoid unnecessary sun exposure to treated areas and follow your aftercare instructions regarding sunscreen and physical protection.

Health Canada and the AAD both recommend avoiding tanning around laser hair-removal treatments.

items.question: How should I protect my skin after treatment?
items.answer:
Once appropriate for your treatment area, use broad-spectrum sunscreen and protect the skin from unnecessary UV exposure.

For exposed areas, an SPF 30+ broad-spectrum sunscreen is a common dermatology recommendation.

items.question: Is there downtime?
items.answer:
Laser hair removal generally has little to no significant downtime for many clients.

You can usually return to your normal routine once your skin has settled, but you should follow your individualized aftercare instructions

items.question: Can I get laser if I have dark skin and a history of hyperpigmentation?
items.answer:
You may still be a candidate.

However, a history of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation is important information to disclose because darker skin can have a higher risk of unwanted pigment changes following laser procedures.

Your skin will be assessed before treatment, and a conservative approach may be appropriate.

items.question: What areas can be treated?
items.answer:
Depending on suitability, laser hair reduction can be performed on many areas, including:

Underarms

Bikini line

Brazilian

Legs

Arms

Chest

Stomach

Face

Chin

Upper lip

Neck

Not every area is appropriate for every client, so suitability is assessed individually.

items.question: Can I get full-body laser?
items.answer:
Yes, if you are an appropriate candidate.

Full-body treatment includes multiple treatment areas and requires appropriate preparation.

Your appointment length and treatment plan will depend on the areas being treated.

items.question: Does laser work on hormonal hair?
items.answer:
Does laser work on hormonal hair?It can reduce hormonal hair, but hormonal factors may cause new hair growth over time.

This is particularly relevant for facial hair.

Laser can still be very helpful, but maintenance treatments may be necessary.

If you experience sudden or significant new facial hair growth, discussing possible hormonal causes with a healthcare professional may also be appropriate.

items.question: Who is Not a Candidate?
items.answer:
Laser treatment may need to be postponed or declined if you have circumstances that make treatment unsuitable or increase risk.

This may include:

Recent tanning or sunburn

Active skin infection or significant inflammation

Open wounds in the treatment area

Certain medications that increase photosensitivity

Certain medical conditions affecting healing

Pregnancy

Certain recent cosmetic treatments

Hair that does not contain enough pigment for effective laser targeting

Your suitability will be assessed before treatment.
