items.question: What is Dark Lip Neutralization?
items.answer:
Dark lip neutralization is a corrective PMU technique designed specifically for lips with darker, cool-toned or uneven pigmentation.

Rather than immediately trying to make the lips pink, the process focuses on correcting the underlying colour .

Depending on your natural lip tone, the lips may require warm corrective pigments before a desired target colour can be introduced.

items.question: Is Dark Lip Neutralization the same as Lip Blush?
items.answer:
No.

Although both treatments involve cosmetic lip pigmentation, they have different purposes.

Lip Blush primarily enhances the colour, definition and appearance of the lips.

Dark Lip Neutralization focuses on correcting unwanted darker or cool tones first.

A client with significant lip hyperpigmentation may require neutralization before a lighter or more vibrant lip colour can be considered.

items.question: Will my lips be pink after one session?
items.answer:
Usually, no.

This is one of the most important things to understand before booking.

Dark lip neutralization is often a process rather than a one-session transformation .

Your natural pigmentation, undertones, skin characteristics and how your lips respond to pigment all influence the result.

Some clients may require multiple sessions to achieve their desired level of correction.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer:
There is no universal number.

Some clients may see significant improvement after one session, while others may require additional 2-3 sessions.

The number of sessions depends on:

The depth and intensity of your natural lip pigmentation

Your undertone

Previous lip PMU

How your skin retains pigment

Your healing response

Your desired final colour

Your lips must be allowed to fully heal before determining whether another session is appropriate.

items.question: How far apart are sessions?
items.answer:
Additional sessions should only be performed once the lips have adequately healed and the previous result can be properly assessed.

In many cases, this means waiting approximately 6–8 weeks or longer , depending on how your lips have healed.

The exact timing will be determined based on your individual healing and treatment plan.

items.question: Can everyone with dark lips get neutralization?
items.answer:
Not necessarily.

Dark lip neutralization requires an individual assessment.

The cause, depth and colour of your lip pigmentation matter.

Some lips may be excellent candidates for neutralization, while others may require a different approach or may not be suitable for PMU.

If you have previous lip PMU, please provide clear photos before booking.

items.question: What causes dark or uneven lips?
items.answer:
Lip pigmentation can have many causes.

It may be influenced by:

Genetics

Natural skin pigmentation

Sun exposure

Hormonal changes

Previous irritation or inflammation

Lip licking or chronic irritation

Smoking

Certain medications

Previous lip procedures

Post-inflammatory pigmentation

The cause cannot always be determined from appearance alone.

If you have a new, rapidly changing or unexplained pigmentation change, medical evaluation may be appropriate before cosmetic treatment.

items.question: Will neutralization change my natural lip colour permanently?
items.answer:
The goal is to create a semi-permanent cosmetic improvement , not permanently change the underlying biology of your lips.

Pigment gradually fades over time.

Your natural pigmentation remains underneath the implanted cosmetic pigment.

items.question: How long does lip neutralization last?
items.answer:
Results vary from person to person.

Lip PMU gradually fades as the pigment is metabolized and the skin naturally renews.

Factors such as sun exposure, skincare, lifestyle, smoking, lip products and individual skin characteristics can influence longevity.

A maintenance session may eventually be recommended to refresh the result.

items.question: Will my lips look darker immediately after the appointment?
items.answer:
They may.

Freshly treated lips can appear significantly more intense, brighter or darker than the healed result.

You may also experience temporary swelling and sensitivity.

Do not judge your final result immediately after your appointment.

The colour will change considerably during healing.

items.question: What is the healing process like?
items.answer:
Lip healing happens in stages.

FIRST FEW DAYS

Your lips may appear:

Brighter

Darker

More saturated

Slightly swollen

Tender

Dry or tight

This is normal after the procedure.

DAYS 3–7

The lips may begin to dry and peel.

The colour can appear uneven or much lighter during this stage.

WEEKS 2–4

The colour gradually begins to settle.

The lips may still appear different from the immediate post-treatment result.

WEEKS 8-12+

The healed colour can be assessed more accurately.

This is when we determine whether additional correction is appropriate.

items.question: Will my lips peel?
items.answer:
The lips usually peel within the first 2-7 days.

Peeling is part of the healing process for many clients.

Do not pick, pull or force the skin off.

Allow your lips to heal naturally and follow the aftercare instructions provided after your appointment.

items.question: What if my lips look lighter after peeling?
items.answer:
This can be completely normal.

After the outer layer of treated skin sheds, the colour may temporarily appear very light or muted.

This is sometimes referred to as the “ghosting” stage of lip PMU.

Do not assume the treatment has failed.

Give your lips time to fully heal before evaluating the result.

items.question: Will dark lip neutralization make my lips look unnatural?
items.answer:
The goal is a balanced and natural-looking correction .

However, freshly treated lips can look much more intense than the final healed result.

Your treatment plan and pigment selection are based on your existing lip colour and desired outcome.

items.question: Can you make my lips pink?
items.answer:
The final colour depends on your starting lip pigmentation.

If your lips have significant dark or cool pigmentation, attempting to immediately implant a light pink colour can produce an undesirable result.

The priority is to first create appropriate colour balance.

Once the lips have healed, additional colour enhancement may be considered if appropriate.

items.question: Can you neutralize very dark or purple lips?
items.answer:
Potentially, yes.

However, very dark or highly pigmented lips may require a more gradual corrective approach.

The darker or more complex the underlying pigmentation, the more important it is to manage expectations and avoid trying to correct too aggressively in one session.

items.question: Can you neutralize brown lips?
items.answer:
Brown pigmentation can sometimes be addressed through corrective colour theory and an individualized pigment selection.

However, the exact approach depends on whether the pigmentation is warm, cool, deep or mixed.

Your lips should be assessed before determining the appropriate pigment strategy.

items.question: What should I expect after my appointment?
items.answer:
Your lips may go through several colour changes during healing.

Fresh

More intense and saturated.

Peeling

Dryness and flaking may occur.

Lightening and Darkening

The colour may temporarily appear very soft or faded or very dark.

Settling

The colour gradually becomes more visible and balanced.

Healed

Your final colour can be properly assessed.

Trust the healing process.

items.question: Who may not be a candidate?
items.answer:
Lip neutralization may need to be postponed or declined if you have:

Active cold sores

Open cuts or wounds

Active infection

Significant lip irritation

Severe dryness or cracking

Active dermatitis or other inflammation around the treatment area

Recent aggressive lip treatments

Certain medical conditions or medications affecting healing or bleeding

Previous PMU that requires removal before new work

Your suitability will be determined during consultation.

items.question: Can dark lip neutralization make my lips darker?
items.answer:
Temporary darkening or increased colour intensity can occur immediately after treatment.

However, inappropriate pigment selection, excessive trauma or treating skin that is not suitable can contribute to undesirable results.

This is why colour correction should be individualized rather than using the same pigment on every client.

items.question: Is lip neutralization guaranteed to remove pigmentation?
items.answer:
No.

No cosmetic treatment can guarantee complete removal of natural lip pigmentation.

The goal is to improve colour balance and appearance , not promise a specific shade or outcome.

Your final result depends on your individual skin, pigmentation and healing response.

items.question: Can I get lip neutralization while pregnant or breastfeeding?
items.answer:
For safety and policy reasons, Aniekanvas Aesthetics may postpone lip PMU during pregnancy and/or breastfeeding.

Please disclose your pregnancy or breastfeeding status before booking.

items.question: Can I get lip neutralization if I have cold sores?
items.answer:
A history of cold sores does not necessarily mean you cannot receive lip PMU , but it is extremely important to disclose this before booking.

Lip procedures can potentially trigger a cold sore outbreak in susceptible individuals.

Your provider may recommend discussing antiviral prevention with your healthcare professional before treatment.

Do not self-prescribe medication.

If you currently have an active cold sore or lesion, your appointment should be postponed until the area has completely healed.

items.question: Can I get lip neutralization if I have previous lip tattooing?
items.answer:
Possibly, but previous pigment can significantly affect the treatment plan.

Old pigment may alter how new corrective colours heal.

A consultation or photo assessment is required before determining whether you are a suitable candidate.

items.question: Is lip neutralization painful?
items.answer:
Everyone experiences the procedure differently.

A topical anesthetic may be used to improve comfort, where appropriate.

You may experience pressure, vibration, tingling or sensitivity during the procedure.

Lip sensitivity can vary significantly from person to person.

items.question: What is Inkless Stretch Mark & Scar Revision?
items.answer:
Inkless Stretch Mark & Scar Revision is a non-pigment skin-revision treatment designed to improve the appearance, texture and overall visibility of stretch marks and certain types of scars .

Unlike traditional stretch mark camouflage, no tattoo ink or skin-coloured pigment is implanted into the skin. Instead, the treatment uses controlled skin stimulation and a specialized topical treatment protocol to encourage the skin's natural renewal and repair processes.

The goal is to gradually soften the appearance of the treated area rather than simply covering the marks with colour.

items.question: How does Inkless Stretch Mark & Scar Revision work?
items.answer:
The treatment uses controlled stimulation of the skin combined with a specialized topical serum or skin-supporting formulation.

The controlled stimulation creates a wound-healing response within the treated area, which may encourage collagen and elastin remodeling over time.

As the skin remodels, the appearance of the stretch marks or scar may become less noticeable.

Your treatment protocol is customized according to the age, depth, texture, colour and location of the scar or stretch marks.

items.question: Is Inkless Stretch Mark & Scar Revision permanent?
items.answer:
The treatment is designed to create long-term improvement , but results cannot be guaranteed to remain unchanged permanently.

Stretch marks and scars are permanent changes to the skin's structure, so the goal is to improve their appearance rather than completely erase them.

The longevity of your results can be influenced by your skin, age of the marks, lifestyle, sun exposure, hormonal changes and future changes in body size.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer: Most clients may begin to see noticeable improvement after approximately 2–3 sessions . The number of sessions needed varies depending on the age, depth, size, and severity of the stretch marks, as well as your individual skin response.

items.question: Does the treatment hurt?
items.answer: Most clients tolerate the treatment well. You may experience mild discomfort, sensitivity, or a slight tingling sensation during the procedure. Your comfort will be monitored throughout your appointment.

items.question: Who is a good candidate for Inkless Stretch Mark Revision?
items.answer: Clients with light, faded, or mature stretch marks may be ideal candidates. The treatment can be performed on different skin tones; however, additional precautions may be necessary for deeper skin tones because of the potential for post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

items.question: Can fresh stretch marks be treated?
items.answer: Stretch marks should be at least 3 months old before beginning treatment according to our treatment guidelines. During your consultation, your technician will assess the area and determine whether it is appropriate to treat.

items.question: Item descriptionWill I see results immediately?
items.answer: No. Inkless Stretch Mark Revision produces gradual results as the skin goes through its natural healing and regeneration process. Some clients may begin noticing changes during the healing period, while more significant results develop over time.

items.question: How long does the skin take to heal?
items.answer: Healing varies from person to person. According to our treatment guidelines, clients may heal in approximately 2–6 weeks , depending on the treated area and individual skin response.

items.question: Is there downtime after the treatment?
items.answer:
Downtime is generally minimal. You may experience temporary redness, mild swelling, sensitivity, or irritation following treatment. You should follow all aftercare instructions carefully while your skin heals.

Avoid sunbathing for 30 days and avoid excessive sweating, swimming, baths, or soaking the treated area in water for 7 days .

items.question: What side effects can occur?
items.answer:
Temporary redness, irritation, sensitivity, and mild swelling may occur following treatment. In rare cases, scarring or hyperpigmentation may occur, particularly in clients with darker skin tones.

Following your pre-care and aftercare instructions is important to support proper healing.

items.question: How is Inkless Revision different from Stretch Mark Camouflage?
items.answer:
Inkless Stretch Mark Revision does not use tattoo pigment . Instead, it focuses on stimulating the skin's natural healing response and improving the appearance and texture of the stretch marks.

Traditional stretch mark camouflage involves implanting pigment into the skin to visually blend the stretch marks with the surrounding skin.

items.question: Can Inkless Revision be performed on all skin tones?
items.answer:
The treatment may be suitable for a variety of skin tones. However, every client’s skin responds differently. Clients with deeper skin tones may require additional precautions because of the increased risk of hyperpigmentation following skin trauma.

A consultation and assessment of the treatment area are recommended before proceeding.

items.question: How long is an Inkless Stretch Mark Revision appointment?
items.answer: Appointments typically take approximately 1–2 hours , depending on the size and condition of the treatment area.

items.question: What areas of the body can be treated?
items.answer:
Inkless Stretch Mark Revision may be performed on many areas of the body, including:

Stomach/abdomen

Thighs

Hips

Arms

Breasts

Other areas where stretch marks are present

The treatment area will be assessed before treatment to determine suitability.

items.question: Can Inkless Revision be combined with other treatments?
items.answer: In some cases, Inkless Revision may be combined with other skin treatments, such as laser therapy or microneedling. However, treatments should not automatically be combined. Your technician can determine the most appropriate treatment approach based on your skin and treatment goals.

items.question: How much does Inkless Stretch Mark Revision cost?
items.answer:
Pricing depends on the size of the treatment area and the number of sessions recommended. Treatment typically ranges from $250-500 per session .

-Scar Often require fewer sessions , typically 3-4 sessions

-Stretch Marks usually require more sessions, typically 4-6 sessions

-Pricing remains the same but expectations differ

PACKAGE

Single session - no discount

3 sessions - 10% discount

4 sessions - 15% discount

6 sessions - 20% discount

items.question: When will I see the final results?
items.answer: Results are gradual. While some improvement may become noticeable during the healing process, the full outcome can take approximately 2–6 months as the skin continues to regenerate and produce collagen.

items.question: What aftercare is required?
items.answer:
Following your aftercare instructions is essential for proper healing. Depending on your treatment, aftercare may include:

Avoiding direct sun exposure

Keeping the treated area properly cared for and moisturized as instructed

Avoiding excessive sweating during the recommended healing period

Avoiding swimming, baths, and soaking the treated area for the recommended period

Following all specific instructions provided by your technician

items.question: Can I have Inkless Stretch Mark Revision while pregnant or breastfeeding?
items.answer:
It is generally recommended to wait until after pregnancy and breastfeeding before undergoing Inkless Stretch Mark Revision. Pregnancy and breastfeeding can affect the skin and may make results less predictable.

If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or recently postpartum, please wait until you have completed this stage before booking your treatment.

IMPORTANT TO KNOW

Inkless Stretch Mark Revision is designed to improve the appearance of stretch marks—it does not guarantee complete removal. Results vary from client to client and depend on the age, depth, severity, and characteristics of the stretch marks, as well as individual healing.

A consultation and assessment are recommended before beginning a treatment plan.

items.question: What is Cold Plasma?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma is an advanced aesthetic treatment that uses low-temperature plasma technology to interact with the skin's surface. Unlike treatments that rely on intense heat to remove layers of skin, Cold Plasma works more gently while stimulating the skin's natural renewal processes.

Depending on your treatment plan, Cold Plasma may be used to help improve the appearance of:

Acne-prone skin

Post-acne marks

Fine lines

Wrinkless

Uneven skin texture

Enlarged pores

Eczema

Psoriasis

Nail Fungus

Stretch marks

Certain types of scars

Overall skin rejuvenation

Every treatment is customized based on your skin concerns and goals

items.question: How does Cold Plasma work?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma creates ionized gas that interacts with the skin's surface while producing very little heat.

The treatment is designed to support the skin's natural repair processes and may stimulate collagen production over time.

Unlike some more aggressive resurfacing treatments, Cold Plasma generally causes less disruption to the skin barrier, making it an appealing option for many clients seeking minimal downtime.

items.question: What skin concerns can Cold Plasma help with?
items.answer:

Eczema

Stretch marks

Certain types of scars

Overall skin rejuvenation

During your consultation, we'll determine whether Cold Plasma is appropriate for your specific concerns.

items.question: Is Cold Plasma safe for darker skin tones?
items.answer:
Yes—Cold Plasma is generally considered suitable for a wide range of skin tones because it is not primarily relying on high-temperature thermal damage.

However, every client is individually assessed before treatment.

If you have a history of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation or sensitive skin, your treatment plan may be adjusted accordingly.

items.question: Does Cold Plasma hurt?
items.answer:
Most clients describe the treatment as comfortable.

You may feel:

Mild warmth

Tingling

A light buzzing sensation

Gentle prickling

Pain tolerance varies from person to person, but the treatment is generally well tolerated.

items.question: Is numbing cream required?
items.answer:
In many cases, numbing cream is not necessary.

However, comfort is always considered, and recommendations depend on the treatment area and treatment intensity.

items.question: How long does a treatment take?
items.answer:
Appointment length depends on the area being treated.

Approximate treatment times:

Small areas: 20–30 minutes

Face treatments: 45–60 minutes

Larger body areas: 45–90 minutes

Your appointment includes consultation, skin assessment and personalized treatment planning.

items.question: How many sessions will I need?
items.answer:
The number of sessions depends on:

Your skin concern

The treatment area

Your skin's response

Your goals

Many clients benefit from a series of treatments rather than expecting complete improvement after a single session.

Your personalized treatment plan will be discussed during your consultation.

items.question: When will I see results?
items.answer:
Some clients notice improvements in skin brightness and texture shortly after treatment.

Collagen remodeling takes time, so improvements in texture, firmness and the appearance of scars may continue developing over several weeks.

Results vary between individuals.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma tighten skin?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma may help improve the appearance of mild skin laxity by supporting collagen production.

It is not a surgical skin-tightening procedure, and results vary depending on the individual and the condition being treated.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma help acne?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma may be incorporated into treatment plans for acne-prone skin.

It may help improve the appearance of active breakouts and support healthier-looking skin as part of an overall skincare approach.

It is not a cure for acne, and ongoing management may still be necessary.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma help acne scars?
items.answer:
Yes, Cold Plasma may help improve the appearance of certain acne scars over time.

Because scar improvement depends on collagen remodeling, multiple sessions are often recommended.

The degree of improvement depends on the type, depth and age of the scar.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma help stretch marks?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma may help improve the appearance and texture of stretch marks by supporting the skin's natural renewal process.

Older stretch marks typically require more patience and multiple treatments.

Results vary depending on the individual.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma help surgical or injury scars?
items.answer:
In many cases, Cold Plasma can be incorporated into scar-revision treatment plans once the scar has fully healed and is appropriate for treatment.

The scar will be assessed during your consultation before determining suitability.

items.question: Is there downtime?
items.answer:
One of the benefits of Cold Plasma is that downtime is generally minimal.

Some clients experience:

Mild redness

Warmth

Temporary sensitivity

Slight dryness

These effects are usually temporary.

Aftercare instructions should still be followed carefully.

items.question: Will my skin peel?
items.answer:
Some clients experience mild dryness or light flaking, while others experience little to no peeling.

This depends on the treatment intensity and your individual skin response.

Avoid picking or scratching the skin if flaking occurs.

items.question: Can I wear makeup afterward?
items.answer:
It is generally recommended to avoid makeup immediately after treatment.

Your personalized aftercare instructions will explain when it is appropriate to resume cosmetics.

items.question: Can I exercise after Cold Plasma?
items.answer:
Avoid activities that cause excessive sweating immediately after treatment if your skin is still warm or sensitive.

Allow your skin time to settle before returning to strenuous exercise.

items.question: Can I go in the sun after treatment?
items.answer:
Protecting your skin from UV exposure is extremely important.

Avoid excessive sun exposure during healing, and once appropriate, wear a broad-spectrum sunscreen on exposed treated areas.

items.question: Can I combine Cold Plasma with other treatments?
items.answer:
Yes—Cold Plasma may be incorporated into combination treatment plans.

Depending on your goals, it may be combined with other aesthetic services at appropriate intervals.

Your treatment plan will be customized to ensure treatments are performed safely.

items.question: Who is not a candidate for Cold Plasma?
items.answer:
Treatment may need to be postponed or declined if you have:

Active skin infection

Open wounds

Significant skin irritation

Sunburn

Certain active inflammatory skin conditions

Recent aggressive cosmetic treatments

Pregnancy (depending on treatment area and protocol)

Other contraindications identified during consultation

Your suitability will always be assessed before treatment.

items.question: What should I disclose before treatment?
items.answer:
Please let us know if you have:

Pregnancy or breastfeeding

Active skin conditions

Recent cosmetic procedures

Prescription skincare use

History of abnormal scarring

Medical conditions affecting healing

Allergies or sensitivities

Current medications

This helps us determine the safest and most appropriate treatment plan.

items.question: Can Cold Plasma replace skincare?
items.answer:
No.

Cold Plasma works best as part of a comprehensive skincare plan.

Healthy daily habits—including sunscreen, moisturizing and appropriate home care—help support and maintain your results.

items.question: What makes Cold Plasma different from other skin treatments?
items.answer:
Cold Plasma offers a non-invasive approach that focuses on supporting the skin's natural renewal processes with minimal downtime.

At Aniekanvas Aesthetics, every treatment begins with a personalized consultation so we can recommend the most appropriate treatment for your skin—not simply the most popular one.

items.question: What should I expect after my appointment?
items.answer:
Immediately after treatment, your skin may feel:

Warm

Slightly pink

Sensitive

Fresh and refreshed

Over the following days, your skin may continue to improve as it recovers.

For concerns such as scars, stretch marks and skin texture, improvements typically develop gradually over a series of treatments.

Patience and consistency are key.

Beautiful, healed brows start with proper preparation and aftercare. Please read the following instructions carefully before and after your Ombre Brow appointment. Following these guidelines will help support proper healing, pigment retention, and the best possible results.

## OMBRE BROW PRE-CARE

7 Days Before Your Appointment

Avoid excessive sun exposure, tanning beds, and intentional tanning.

Do not use self-tanner on or around the brow area.

Avoid facial treatments that may irritate or exfoliate the brow area, including chemical peels, strong exfoliants, and aggressive facials.

If you regularly use retinol, prescription retinoids, or strong exfoliating products around your forehead and brow area, discontinue them according to your skincare professional's guidance and allow the skin to recover before your appointment.

Avoid waxing, threading, or aggressively tweezing the brows immediately before your appointment. We will shape the brows during your service.

48–72 Hours Before Your Appointment

Avoid excessive alcohol consumption.

Avoid recreational drugs.

Avoid activities that cause excessive sweating if possible.

Do not schedule Botox, fillers, or other injectable treatments around the forehead, brow, or eye area immediately before your appointment.

Avoid using harsh exfoliating products on or around the brows.

24 Hours Before Your Appointment

Avoid aspirin or other blood-thinning medications unless they have been prescribed to you. Never stop prescribed medication without speaking with your healthcare provider.

Avoid excessive caffeine if you are sensitive to it, as it may increase sensitivity during the appointment.

Drink plenty of water and arrive well hydrated.

Get a good night's rest.

On the Day of Your Appointment

Please arrive with clean skin around the brow area.

Do not apply makeup, brow pencil, brow gel, oils, or heavy skincare products directly on the brows.

Do not drink coffee or caffeinated drinks.

Avoid working out immediately before your appointment.

Eat a light meal beforehand.

Bring reference photos if there is a particular brow style you love. Your natural brow structure, skin type, and facial features will always be taken into consideration when designing your brows.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOINTMENT IF:

Your appointment may need to be postponed if you have:

An active rash, irritation, sunburn, eczema flare, or open wound around the brow area.

An active infection or significant inflammation around the treatment area.

Recently undergone a procedure that has left the brow area compromised or sensitive.

Significant swelling or irritation around the eyes or forehead.

Any condition or medication that may affect healing or increase bleeding risk that has not been discussed with your artist.

If you are unsure whether something affects your eligibility for the service, please contact us before your appointment .

## OMBRE BROW AFTERCARE

Proper aftercare is essential for achieving beautiful, even, long-lasting results.

Immediately after your appointment, your brows may appear darker, bolder, warmer, or more defined than your desired healed result. This is completely normal. The colour will soften as your brows heal.

## FIRST 24 HOURS

Keep the brows clean and protected according to the aftercare instructions provided at your appointment.

Avoid touching your brows with unwashed hands.

Do not apply makeup directly on the brows.

Avoid excessive sweating.

Avoid workouts, saunas, steam rooms, and hot yoga.

Keep hair products, sprays, oils, and other cosmetic products away from the brows.

Do not pick, scratch, rub, or peel the treated area.

## DAYS 2–7

Your brows may begin to feel dry, tight, or slightly itchy. Light flaking or peeling can occur as part of the normal healing process.

## DO:

Keep the area clean using the cleansing method recommended by your artist.

Allow any natural flaking to fall away on its own.

Follow the specific aftercare product instructions provided at your appointment.

Sleep carefully to avoid unnecessary rubbing or pressure on the brows.

## DO NOT:

Pick or peel the brows.

Scratch the treated area.

Use makeup directly on the brows while they are actively healing.

Apply exfoliants, retinol, acids, or other active skincare products to the brow area.

Use facial scrubs or cleansing brushes over the brows.

Wax, thread, or tint the brows while they are healing.

Swim in pools, hot tubs, lakes, or oceans.

Use saunas or steam rooms.

Expose the brows to prolonged direct sunlight or tanning.

## DAYS 7–14

The brows may temporarily appear lighter than expected. You may even experience a period where the pigment appears to have faded significantly.

Do not panic!

This is a normal part of the healing process. The pigment can appear muted or "disappear" temporarily while the skin continues to heal. Your brows will gradually settle and reveal their healed colour.

Continue avoiding aggressive skincare, exfoliation, tanning, and unnecessary irritation around the brows.

## AFTER 2 WEEKS

Once the skin has completely healed:

Resume your normal skincare routine gradually.

Continue protecting your brows from prolonged sun exposure.

Use SPF around the brow area once the skin is fully healed.

Avoid applying strong exfoliating products directly over the brows whenever possible.

Remember that excessive sun exposure and aggressive skincare can contribute to premature fading.

## THE HEALING PROCESS

Days 1–3

Brows are typically bold, defined, and darker than the final result. Mild redness or sensitivity may occur.

Days 3–7

The brows may begin to dry, flake, or peel. Do not pick or pull at the flakes.

Days 7–14

Brows can appear significantly lighter or uneven while the skin continues to heal.

Weeks 3–6

The colour gradually settles and the brows begin to look more like their healed result.

6–8 Weeks

Your brows are considered sufficiently healed for your scheduled perfecting session, if recommended.

## YOUR PERFECTING SESSION

An initial Ombre Brow appointment is designed to establish the shape, colour, and overall foundation of your brows.

Because every person's skin heals and retains pigment differently, a 6–8 week perfecting session may be recommended to assess healed results and make appropriate adjustments.

Your artist will evaluate your healed brows and determine whether additional pigment or refinement is needed.

Please do not judge your final result during the first few days of healing. The brows go through several stages before the true healed colour becomes visible.

## IMPORTANT

Healing varies from person to person. Results are influenced by skin type, lifestyle, skincare routine, sun exposure, medications, and individual healing and pigment retention.

Following your aftercare instructions does not guarantee a specific healed result, but it gives your brows the best opportunity to heal beautifully and retain pigment properly.

If you have concerns during the healing process, please contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics before attempting to treat the area yourself.

careGuides.title: Laser Hair Removal Pre-Care & Aftercare
careGuides.content:
Laser Hair Removal Pre-Care & Aftercare

Proper preparation and aftercare help support a comfortable treatment, healthy skin, and the best possible laser hair reduction results.

Please read these instructions carefully before your appointment and follow them throughout your treatment plan.

## LASER HAIR REMOVAL PRE-CARE

## 2–4 WEEKS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid Removing the Hair From the Root

Do not wax, tweeze, thread, epilate, or use other hair-removal methods that pull the hair from the root.

Laser hair removal works by targeting the hair follicle, so the follicle needs to be present for the laser to effectively treat it.

Shaving is allowed and encouraged.

If you have recently waxed, tweezed, threaded, or epilated the treatment area, please let us know before your appointment.

## AVOID SUN EXPOSURE

Avoid intentional tanning and prolonged direct sun exposure on the treatment area before your appointment.

This includes:

Tanning beds

Sunbathing

Outdoor tanning

Spray tans

Self-tanning products

Recent tanning can increase the amount of pigment in the skin and may increase the risk of unwanted skin reactions.

If the treatment area is significantly tanned or sunburned, your appointment may need to be postponed.

Always use SPF

Use broad-spectrum sunscreen on exposed treatment areas and reapply as directed, particularly when spending time outdoors.

## 5–7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid using irritating or aggressive products on the treatment area, including:

Retinoids/retinol

Strong exfoliating acids

Chemical exfoliants

Scrubs

Benzoyl peroxide

Other products that cause significant irritation or sensitivity

If you use prescription skincare or medication that may increase photosensitivity, please disclose this before treatment.

Do not stop prescribed medication without speaking with your healthcare provider.

## 24–48 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

## SHAVE THE TREATMENT AREA

Shave the treatment area approximately 12–24 hours before your appointment , unless you have been given different instructions.

Shaving allows the laser to target the follicle while minimizing excess hair above the skin's surface.

Avoid shaving immediately before your appointment if shaving tends to cause significant irritation, razor burn, or cuts.

Please do NOT:

Wax

Tweeze

Thread

Epilate

Use depilatory cream unless specifically approved

Bleach the hair

## ON THE DAY OF YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please arrive with clean skin.

The treatment area should be free from:

Lotion

Body oils

Deodorant

Perfume

Makeup

Sunscreen

Heavy skincare products

For underarm treatments, avoid deodorant immediately before your appointment.

For facial treatments, arrive with a clean face and minimal skincare or makeup.

Wear loose, comfortable clothing when treating larger or sensitive areas to minimize friction afterward.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOINTMENT IF:

Contact us before your appointment if you have:

An active sunburn.

Significant recent tanning.

An open wound or broken skin in the treatment area.

An active rash, infection, or significant irritation.

Severe inflammation or skin sensitivity.

A new medication that may cause photosensitivity.

Recently undergone a chemical peel or other skin-resurfacing treatment in the treatment area.

Recently had a procedure that has not fully healed.

Any new medical or skin-related concern that may affect treatment.

Your safety comes first. If the skin is not in an appropriate condition for treatment, we may recommend postponing your appointment.

## LASER HAIR REMOVAL AFTERCARE

Immediately after treatment, the skin may appear slightly pink or red and you may notice small bumps or swelling around individual hair follicles.

This can look similar to mild razor burn or tiny raised bumps.

These temporary reactions can be a normal response to treatment and typically settle with time.

## FIRST 24–48 HOURS

## DO:

Keep the treated area clean.

Wear loose, breathable clothing when possible.

Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer if recommended.

Apply a cool compress if the area feels warm or uncomfortable.

Drink plenty of water.

Follow any personalized aftercare instructions provided at your appointment.

## AVOID:

Hot showers or baths.

Saunas and steam rooms.

Hot tubs.

Intense workouts.

Excessive sweating.

Swimming.

Fragranced products on the treated area.

Scrubs or exfoliating products.

Picking, scratching, or rubbing the skin.

## SUN & HEAT PROTECTION

Protect treated skin from unnecessary sun exposure.

For exposed areas:

Avoid intentional tanning.

Use broad-spectrum SPF as appropriate once the skin is comfortable.

Wear protective clothing when possible.

Avoid tanning beds.

Sun exposure following laser treatment can increase the risk of unwanted pigmentation changes, particularly when the skin is irritated.

## DAYS 3–7

You may notice what looks like hair growth after your treatment.

This does not necessarily mean the laser did not work.

Treated hairs can gradually work their way out of the follicle and may appear to be growing before they shed.

During this stage:

Continue shaving as needed.

Do not wax or tweeze the treated hairs.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation while the skin is still sensitive.

Once the skin is fully comfortable and no longer irritated, gentle exfoliation may be introduced according to your provider's instructions.

## WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER LASER HAIR REMOVAL

Laser hair removal is a progressive hair-reduction treatment , not a one-time permanent hair removal procedure.

Hair grows in different cycles, and the laser is most effective when the hair is in an appropriate growth phase.

Because not all hairs are in the same growth phase at the same time, a series of treatments is generally required.

Over the course of your treatment plan, you may notice:

Slower hair growth

Finer hair

Less dense hair

Longer periods between shaving

Reduced ingrown hairs for some clients

Gradual reduction in overall hair growth

Results vary from person to person.

Factors such as hair colour, hair thickness, skin tone, hormonal factors, treatment area, treatment consistency, and individual response can influence results.

## BETWEEN YOUR APPOINTMENTS

Shaving is okay.

You may shave between treatments as needed.

Avoid root-removal methods.

Do not wax, tweeze, thread, or epilate the treated area between sessions because these methods remove the follicle that the laser needs to target during your next treatment.

Stay consistent.

Your treatment schedule is designed around the natural hair-growth cycle. Attending appointments at the recommended intervals can help maximize your results.

## FACIAL LASER HAIR REMOVAL

After facial treatment:

Avoid heavy makeup while the skin is irritated.

Avoid strong active skincare products immediately after treatment.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Keep the skin moisturized.

Protect the area from sun exposure.

Follow any additional instructions provided specifically for your skin.

If you experience significant irritation, stop using potentially irritating skincare products until the skin has recovered.

## UNDERARM & BIKINI AREA

These areas can be more sensitive because of friction, sweat, and clothing.

For the first 24–48 hours:

Wear loose-fitting clothing.

Avoid tight underwear or clothing that causes excessive friction.

Avoid intense workouts if they cause significant sweating or irritation.

Keep the area clean and dry.

Avoid fragranced products if the skin is sensitive.

## IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

Mild redness, warmth, swelling, and temporary sensitivity can occur after laser hair removal.

However, severe pain, blistering, significant swelling, extensive skin discoloration, or worsening symptoms are not something you should ignore.

If you experience an unusual or severe reaction, contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics promptly and seek appropriate medical care when necessary.

Do not attempt to treat a significant reaction yourself without professional guidance.

## YOUR RESULTS

Laser hair removal requires patience and consistency.

The goal is progressive, long-term hair reduction . Most clients require multiple sessions, and maintenance treatments may be recommended depending on individual hair growth.

Hormonal changes and certain medical conditions can also influence hair growth and may affect the number of treatments required.

For the best results, follow your recommended treatment schedule and continue following your pre-care and aftercare instructions between appointments.

Healthy skin comes first. Beautiful results follow.

careGuides.title: Dark Lip Neutralization Pre-Care & Aftercare
careGuides.content:
Dark Lip Neutralization Pre-Care & Aftercare

Dark Lip Neutralization is a corrective lip pigmentation technique designed to help neutralize unwanted cool, grey, purple, brown, or uneven tones and gradually create a more balanced, healthy-looking lip tone.

Because lip pigmentation and healing are highly individual, results develop gradually over multiple stages and may require more than one session.

Proper preparation and aftercare are essential for supporting healthy healing, colour retention, and the best possible results.

## DARK LIP NEUTRALIZATION PRE-CARE

## 7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Keep your lips well moisturized and hydrated.

Avoid excessive sun exposure and tanning.

Do not use tanning products directly on the lips.

Avoid aggressive lip scrubs or exfoliation.

Avoid chemical peels or other treatments that may irritate the lips or surrounding skin.

Avoid picking, biting, or removing dry skin from the lips.

If your lips are extremely dry, cracked, irritated, or damaged, contact us before your appointment.

Cold Sore Precaution

If you have a history of cold sores, fever blisters, or oral herpes , please disclose this before booking your appointment.

Lip procedures can potentially trigger an outbreak in individuals with a history of cold sores. Your healthcare provider may recommend preventative antiviral medication before and/or after your appointment.

Do not begin prescription medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

## 48–72 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid excessive alcohol consumption.

Avoid recreational drugs.

Avoid excessive sun exposure.

Avoid lip fillers, injectables, chemical peels, or other cosmetic procedures around the lips unless sufficient healing time has been discussed with your practitioner.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation or lip scrubbing.

Keep your lips moisturized.

## 24 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid aspirin or other blood-thinning medications unless prescribed by your healthcare provider. Never discontinue prescribed medication without medical advice.

Limit excessive caffeine if you are sensitive to it.

Drink plenty of water.

Get adequate rest.

Keep your lips moisturized.

## ON THE DAY OF YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please arrive with clean lips.

Remove lipstick, lip liner, gloss, and other lip products before your appointment.

Do not apply lip plumpers or irritating lip products.

Avoid alcohol before your appointment.

Eat a meal before arriving.

Stay well hydrated.

Bring a photo of your preferred healed lip tone if you have one.

During your consultation, we will assess your natural lip colour, undertones, skin condition, and level of pigmentation to determine the appropriate neutralizing approach.

Dark Lip Neutralization is not a one-colour-fits-all service. The pigment selection is customized to your natural lip tone and undertone.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE IF:

Your appointment may need to be postponed if you have:

An active cold sore or fever blister.

An active infection around the lips.

Open cuts, sores, wounds, or significant irritation.

Severely cracked or bleeding lips.

A significant rash or allergic reaction around the mouth.

Recently undergone lip filler or another procedure that has not fully healed.

Any condition or medication that may significantly affect healing or bleeding that has not been discussed with your practitioner.

If you are unsure whether you are ready for your appointment, please contact us before your appointment .

## DARK LIP NEUTRALIZATION AFTERCARE

Your lips will go through several stages during the healing process.

Immediately after your appointment, your lips may appear brighter, darker, more intense, or more saturated than the desired healed result. Mild swelling, tenderness, warmth, or sensitivity may also occur.

This is normal and temporary.

Your immediate colour is NOT your final healed colour.

## FIRST 24 HOURS

Keep your lips clean and protected according to the aftercare instructions provided at your appointment.

Wash your hands before touching your lips.

Apply only the recommended aftercare product.

Avoid touching, rubbing, scratching, or picking at the treated area.

Avoid lipstick, lip gloss, lip liner, and other cosmetic products on the treated area.

Avoid spicy, acidic, salty, or very hot foods and beverages if they cause discomfort.

Drink through a straw if this is more comfortable for you.

Avoid excessive sweating and strenuous exercise.

Avoid alcohol.

Avoid kissing or activities that create unnecessary friction on the lips.

Do not expose your lips to direct sunlight.

## DAYS 2–7

Your lips may become dry, tight, darker, or slightly swollen before the colour begins to soften.

Flaking or peeling may occur.

## DO:

Keep the lips clean.

Keep them appropriately moisturized using the recommended aftercare product.

Allow the skin to shed naturally.

Drink plenty of water.

Follow all individualized instructions provided by your artist.

## DO NOT:

Pick, peel, scratch, or bite the lips.

Pull off loose skin.

Use lip scrubs.

Use exfoliating acids or retinol around the lips.

Apply makeup directly over actively healing areas.

Use plumping or tingling lip products.

Use fragranced or irritating products on the lips.

Swim in pools, hot tubs, lakes, or oceans.

Use saunas or steam rooms.

Expose the lips to prolonged direct sunlight or tanning.

Let your lips heal naturally. Do not try to speed up the peeling process.

## THE "DARKENING" STAGE

It is completely normal for the lips to temporarily appear darker or more intense during the early healing process.

As the skin heals and the surface layer sheds, the colour can appear to change dramatically.

You may experience:

Dark → Bright → Light/Faded → Uneven → Gradually Balanced

This does not necessarily indicate a problem.

The final colour develops gradually beneath the healed skin.

## DAYS 7–14

The lips may appear lighter, muted, or uneven.

Some areas may appear as though the pigment has faded significantly.

Do not panic.

This can be part of the normal healing process as the skin regenerates and the pigment settles.

Continue moisturizing and protecting the lips while they finish healing.

## WEEKS 3–6

The color will gradually become more visible and begin to settle.

Your lips may continue to change in tone during this period.

Avoid judging your final results too early.

Individual pigment retention varies depending on your natural lip pigmentation, skin type, lifestyle, skincare routine, healing process, and other factors.

## YOUR PERFECTING SESSION

Dark Lip Neutralization is often a progressive process rather than a one-session transformation .

Depending on your natural lip pigmentation and how your skin responds, multiple sessions may be recommended.

A perfecting session is typically scheduled after the lips have completely healed , allowing us to accurately assess the healed colour and determine the next step.

Your artist will evaluate:

Pigment retention

Remaining dark areas

Overall tone

Symmetry

Colour balance

Whether additional neutralization is required

Whether the lips are ready for the next stage of treatment

Do not book additional treatment before your lips have fully healed.

## SUN PROTECTION

Once your lips are fully healed, protect them from prolonged sun exposure.

Sun exposure can contribute to pigmentation changes and premature fading.

Use a lip product with appropriate SPF once the area is fully healed and continue keeping your lips moisturized.

## IMPORTANT

Dark Lip Neutralization does not guarantee a specific final lip colour .

Every client's natural lip pigmentation is different. Results depend on factors including natural undertones, melanin levels, skin type, previous lip procedures, lifestyle, sun exposure, skincare, healing, and individual pigment retention.

The goal is to gradually neutralize unwanted tones and create a more balanced appearance , not to guarantee a specific pink or nude shade in one appointment.

Your lips may require multiple sessions to achieve the desired level of correction.

If you have concerns during the healing process, please contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics before attempting to treat the area yourself.

careGuides.title: Inkless Stretch Marks & Scar Revision Pre-Care & Aftercare
careGuides.content:
Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revisio Pre-Care & Aftercare

Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision is a non-invasive skin-revision treatment designed to improve the appearance, texture, and overall tone of selected scars and stretch marks.

The treatment encourages the skin's natural repair and regeneration process. Results develop gradually as the skin heals and remodels.

Proper preparation and aftercare are essential for supporting healthy healing and achieving the best possible results.

## INKLESS SCAR & STRETCH MARK REVISION PRE-CARE

## 7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Prepare the treatment area by keeping the skin healthy, hydrated, and free from irritation.

Keep the treatment area moisturized.

Avoid excessive sun exposure and tanning.

Do not use self-tanner on the treatment area.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Avoid chemical peels or other treatments that may irritate the treatment area.

Avoid picking, scratching, or irritating the scar or stretch marks.

Avoid introducing new skincare products to the treatment area immediately before your appointment.

If the treatment area is irritated, sunburned, or damaged, please contact us before your appointment.

## 5–7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid treatments that may compromise the skin barrier in or around the treatment area, including:

Chemical peels

Microneedling

Dermaplaning

Aggressive exfoliation

Laser treatments

Waxing or other treatments that significantly irritate the skin

Allow the skin sufficient time to recover before your appointment.

## 48–72 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid excessive alcohol consumption.

Avoid recreational drugs.

Avoid prolonged sun exposure.

Avoid tanning beds.

Keep the treatment area clean and moisturized.

Avoid products that cause burning, peeling, or significant irritation.

If you are using prescription skincare or medication that may affect skin healing or sensitivity, please disclose this before treatment.

Do not stop prescribed medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

## 24 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Drink plenty of water.

Get adequate rest.

Avoid excessive alcohol.

Avoid activities that may leave the treatment area irritated.

Do not pick, scratch, or exfoliate the treatment area.

Wear comfortable clothing that will not create unnecessary friction over the treatment area.

## ON THE DAY OF YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please arrive with clean skin.

The treatment area should be free from:

Body oils

Heavy lotions

Self-tanner

Perfume

Makeup

Active skincare products

Avoid shaving immediately before your appointment if shaving causes razor burn or irritation.

Wear loose, comfortable clothing when possible, particularly when treating areas such as the abdomen, thighs, hips, buttocks, or breasts.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOINTMENT IF:

Treatment may need to be postponed if the area has:

An active rash or skin infection.

Open wounds or broken skin.

Significant irritation or inflammation.

A sunburn.

Severe dryness, cracking, or peeling.

An active flare-up of a skin condition.

Recent surgery or a procedure that has not fully healed.

Any unusual change in the appearance of the scar or stretch mark.

Please disclose any relevant medical conditions, medications, recent procedures, or concerns during your consultation.

Your skin must be sufficiently healed and healthy before treatment can be performed.

## INKLESS SCAR & STRETCH MARK REVISION AFTERCARE

Your skin has undergone a controlled skin-revision treatment and needs time to heal.

Immediately after treatment, the area may appear:

Red or pink

Slightly swollen

Warm

Sensitive

Darker or more pronounced

Tight or dry

These reactions can be temporary and may change throughout the healing process.

Do not judge your final results immediately after treatment.

## FIRST 24–48 HOURS

## DO:

Keep the treated area clean.

Follow the cleansing instructions provided at your appointment.

Apply only the recommended aftercare products.

Keep the area protected from friction and irritation.

Wear loose, breathable clothing when possible.

Use a cool compress if recommended for temporary discomfort.

Stay hydrated.

Allow the skin to rest and heal.

## DO NOT:

Touch the treated area unnecessarily.

Pick, scratch, rub, or peel the skin.

Apply makeup or fragranced products to the treated area.

Use harsh soaps or exfoliating products.

Apply acids, retinoids, or other strong active ingredients.

Use scrubs or exfoliating gloves.

Soak the treated area.

Swim in pools, hot tubs, lakes, or oceans.

Use saunas or steam rooms.

Participate in activities that cause excessive sweating or friction.

## DAYS 3–7

The skin may begin to dry, tighten, flake, or change colour.

You may notice that the treated scar or stretch mark temporarily appears darker or more noticeable.

This can be part of the normal healing process.

During this stage:

Continue following your recommended aftercare routine.

Keep the area moisturized with the approved product.

Allow any dry or flaky skin to shed naturally.

Do not pick or pull at the skin.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Continue avoiding unnecessary sun exposure.

Never force the skin to peel.

## DAYS 7–14

The surface of the skin should gradually become calmer and more comfortable.

The treatment area may still appear pink, darker, lighter, or slightly uneven.

This does not necessarily represent the final result.

Continue protecting the area and avoid aggressive treatments until the skin has completely recovered.

## WEEKS 3–6

This is when the deeper skin-remodelling process continues.

The treated area may gradually begin to look:

Smoother

Softer

More blended

More even in tone

Less noticeable

However, improvement develops gradually and varies from person to person.

Collagen remodeling takes time.

## SUN PROTECTION

Sun protection is extremely important after skin-revision treatments.

Once the skin has healed sufficiently, protect the treatment area from excessive sun exposure and use broad-spectrum SPF on exposed areas as appropriate.

Sun exposure can contribute to unwanted pigmentation changes and may affect the appearance of healing skin.

Avoid tanning beds and intentional tanning.

## BETWEEN TREATMENTS

Your skin needs time to heal and remodel before another treatment is performed.

Do not perform additional exfoliating or resurfacing treatments on the area without professional guidance.

Do not pick or manipulate the treated skin.

Maintain a consistent skincare and moisturizing routine once the area is fully healed.

Protect the area from excessive sun exposure.

Attend follow-up appointments as recommended.

Your treatment plan will be customized based on the type, age, location, colour, texture, and severity of the scar or stretch marks.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

Inkless Scar & Stretch Mark Revision is intended to improve the appearance of scars and stretch marks. It does not guarantee complete removal.

The degree of improvement varies depending on:

Age and maturity of the scar or stretch mark

Depth and texture

Colour and pigmentation

Skin type

Location of the treatment area

Individual healing response

Lifestyle

Aftercare compliance

Number of treatments

Some clients may see noticeable improvement after one treatment, while others may require a series of treatments to achieve their desired level of improvement.

The goal is progressive improvement, not overnight removal.

## YOUR NEXT SESSION

A follow-up treatment should only be performed once the skin has adequately healed.

At your follow-up, we will assess:

Skin healing

Texture

Colour changes

Overall improvement

Remaining scar or stretch-mark characteristics

Whether another treatment is appropriate

Treatment intervals will be determined based on your individual healing response and treatment area.

## IMPORTANT

Every person's skin responds differently.

Temporary redness, swelling, sensitivity, dryness, flaking, and changes in pigmentation may occur following treatment.

If you experience severe pain, blistering, significant swelling, pus, spreading redness, signs of infection, or another concerning reaction , contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics promptly and seek appropriate medical attention when necessary.

Do not pick, scratch, or attempt to aggressively treat the area yourself.

Healthy healing is the priority. The visible improvement comes with time.

careGuides.title: DPN / Skin Tag Removal Pre-Care & Aftercare
careGuides.content:
DPN & Skin Tag Removal Pre-Care & Aftercare

DPN (Dermatosis Papulosa Nigra) and skin tag removal is a targeted cosmetic treatment intended to reduce the appearance of selected benign skin growths.

Treatment may involve a controlled cautery/electrodesiccation technique to treat the growth. Following treatment, the area may develop a small crust or scab as part of the normal healing process.

Proper preparation and aftercare are essential to support healthy healing and help minimize the risk of irritation and unwanted pigmentation changes.

## DPN & SKIN TAG REMOVAL PRE-CARE

## 1–2 WEEKS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Prepare the treatment area by keeping the skin healthy and free from irritation.

Avoid excessive sun exposure and tanning.

Do not use tanning beds.

Avoid self-tanner on the treatment area.

Avoid chemical peels on or around the treatment area.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Avoid strong retinoids, acids, or other irritating active skincare products on the treatment area.

Do not pick, squeeze, scratch, or manipulate the growths.

Avoid other cosmetic procedures on the same area unless discussed with your provider.

Sun exposure and skin irritation can affect how the skin responds and heals after treatment.

## 48–72 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please avoid unnecessary irritation to the treatment area.

Do not exfoliate the area.

Avoid waxing or other procedures that may irritate the skin.

Avoid excessive sun exposure.

Avoid tanning.

Keep the area clean and moisturized with gentle products.

Avoid introducing new skincare products immediately before your appointment.

If the area becomes irritated, burned, inflamed, or otherwise compromised, contact us before your appointment.

## MEDICATION & HEALTH DISCLOSURE

Before your appointment, please disclose all relevant:

Prescription medications

Over-the-counter medications

Vitamins and supplements

Allergies

Medical conditions

Skin conditions

History of abnormal or excessive scarring

Previous reactions to cosmetic procedures

In particular, tell us if you use medications that may affect bleeding, wound healing, or your skin's response to treatment.

Never stop aspirin, blood thinners, or any prescribed medication simply because you have an upcoming cosmetic appointment. Speak with your prescribing healthcare professional first.

## ON THE DAY OF YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please arrive with clean skin.

The treatment area should be free from:

Makeup

Heavy creams

Oils

Self-tanner

Perfume or fragranced products

Strong active skincare products

Do not pick, squeeze, or attempt to remove the growths yourself before your appointment.

## IMPORTANT: LESION ASSESSMENT

DPNs and skin tags are generally benign growths, but not every bump, mole, or skin lesion should automatically be treated as a cosmetic growth.

If a growth is:

Changing in size, shape, or colour

Bleeding without an obvious reason

Painful

Crusting repeatedly

Rapidly changing

Unusual in appearance

Difficult to identify

it should be assessed by an appropriate healthcare professional before cosmetic removal.

We may decline treatment or recommend medical assessment when a growth is not appropriate for cosmetic treatment.

A healthcare professional should evaluate suspicious lesions before removal because some skin cancers can resemble benign growths.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOINTMENT IF:

Treatment may need to be postponed if the treatment area has:

An active infection

Open wounds

Significant irritation

A rash

Active inflammation

A sunburn

Blisters

Severe dryness or cracking

Recently undergone another treatment and has not fully healed

Please notify us if there has been any significant change to the treatment area since your consultation.

## DPN & SKIN TAG REMOVAL AFTERCARE

Immediately after treatment, the treated growths may appear:

Darker

Dry

Slightly swollen

Red or pink around the area

Crusted or scabbed

More noticeable than before treatment

These changes can be a normal part of the healing process. A small scab or crust may develop over the treated area as it heals.

Do not judge the final appearance while the area is actively healing.

## FIRST 24 HOURS

## DO:

Keep the treated area clean and protected.

Wash your hands before touching the area.

Follow the cleansing instructions provided at your appointment.

Gently pat the area dry if cleansing is permitted.

Use only the aftercare product recommended for your treatment.

Keep clothing, hair, or other objects from repeatedly rubbing the treated area.

Keep your pillowcase, towels, and anything that contacts the treated area clean.

## DO NOT:

Pick or scratch the treated growths.

Pull off crusts or scabs.

Rub the treated area.

Apply alcohol or hydrogen peroxide unless specifically instructed by a healthcare professional.

Apply makeup directly over open or actively healing areas.

Apply strong skincare products.

Exfoliate.

Use facial scrubs, brushes, or exfoliating pads.

Use retinol, glycolic acid, salicylic acid, or other strong active products on the treated area.

Swim or soak the treated area.

Use hot tubs, saunas, or steam rooms.

## DAYS 2–7

The treated areas may become darker, dry, or crusted before gradually shedding.

This is an important stage of healing.

## MOST IMPORTANT RULE:

## DO NOT PICK THE SCABS.

Allow the crusts to detach naturally.

Prematurely removing a scab can reopen the treated area and may increase the risk of irritation, infection, scarring, or temporary pigmentation changes.

Continue to:

Keep the area clean.

Follow your recommended aftercare routine.

Avoid rubbing and friction.

Avoid exfoliation.

Avoid strong active skincare.

Avoid unnecessary sun exposure.

## MAKEUP

Avoid applying makeup directly over areas that are still open, crusted, scabbed, or actively healing.

Once the skin has completely closed and healed, you may gradually return to your normal makeup routine.

If you are unsure whether an area has healed sufficiently, contact us before applying makeup.

## EXERCISE, HEAT & SWEATING

For the initial healing period, avoid activities that create excessive sweating, heat, friction, or irritation around the treatment area.

Avoid:

Intense workouts

Saunas

Steam rooms

Hot tubs

Prolonged hot showers

Activities that cause significant sweating

Your individualized aftercare instructions may specify a longer avoidance period depending on the treatment area and number of growths treated.

## SUN PROTECTION

Sun protection is particularly important while treated areas are healing.

Avoid direct sun exposure whenever possible.

Once the skin has completely healed and is no longer open or crusted:

Use broad-spectrum SPF 30+ on exposed areas.

Reapply as directed when outdoors.

Avoid tanning beds.

Avoid intentional tanning.

Sun exposure during the healing process can contribute to unwanted pigmentation changes, particularly in deeper skin tones.

## THE HEALING PROCESS

Days 1–3

The treated growths may appear darker and dry. Mild redness, swelling, warmth, or sensitivity may occur.

Days 3–7

A small crust or scab may remain over the treated area.

Do not pick or remove it.

Days 7–14

The crusts may naturally fall away as the skin heals. The area may temporarily appear lighter, darker, pink, or uneven.

Following Weeks

The skin continues to settle and any temporary pigmentation changes may gradually improve.

Healing time varies depending on the size and depth of the treated growth, treatment location, individual skin type, and individual healing response. Electrodessication-treated skin tags may develop a scab that takes approximately one to three weeks to heal.

## PIGMENTATION CHANGES

Temporary pigmentation changes can occur after DPN and skin growth removal.

You may notice:

Temporary darkening

Temporary lightening

Pink or red marks

Uneven pigmentation

These changes can take time to settle.

This is especially important for clients with deeper skin tones, who may be more prone to post-inflammatory pigmentation following skin injury.

Do not attempt to correct pigmentation with strong acids, bleaching products, or aggressive exfoliation while the skin is healing.

## RESULTS

Once the treated growth has healed, the area should appear smoother and clearer.

However:

Removing an existing DPN or skin tag does not prevent new growths from developing in the future.

New DPNs or skin tags may develop due to individual predisposition, genetics, hormonal factors, friction, or other factors.

The treatment is intended to address the growths treated during your appointment, not prevent future growths.

## FOLLOW-UP

A follow-up may be recommended depending on:

Number of growths treated

Size of the growths

Treatment area

Healing response

Pigmentation changes

Individual treatment goals

Please allow the skin to fully heal before determining whether additional treatment is necessary.

Do not schedule additional treatment on an area that is still healing unless specifically instructed.

## WHEN TO CONTACT US

Please contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics if you have concerns about your healing process.

Seek appropriate medical attention if you experience symptoms such as:

Increasing or severe pain

Significant or worsening swelling

Spreading redness

Pus or unusual drainage

Fever

Significant warmth around the area

Blistering or severe skin damage

Any reaction that concerns you

Do not attempt to self-treat a significant reaction.

## IMPORTANT

DPN and skin tag removal involves intentionally treating the skin, so temporary redness, crusting, scabbing, sensitivity, and pigmentation changes may occur.

Individual healing and results vary.

Do not pick, scratch, or prematurely remove treated crusts. Allow your skin to heal naturally.

If you have any concerns during your recovery, contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics before applying new products or attempting additional treatments.

careGuides.title: Cold Plasma Pre-Care & Aftercare
careGuides.content:
Cold Plasma Treatment

Pre-Care & Aftercare

Cold Plasma is a non-invasive skin treatment that uses plasma technology to support skin purification, renewal, and overall skin health.

Depending on the treatment performed, Cold Plasma may be used to support concerns such as congested skin, blemishes, inflammation, uneven-looking skin, and overall skin rejuvenation.

Your skin may respond differently depending on the treatment area, skin type, and the specific Cold Plasma protocol used.

Proper preparation and aftercare help support healthy skin and optimize your results.

## COLD PLASMA PRE-CARE

## 7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Prepare your skin by keeping it calm, hydrated, and free from unnecessary irritation.

Keep your skin moisturized with gentle products.

Avoid excessive sun exposure and tanning.

Do not use self-tanner on the treatment area.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Avoid chemical peels.

Avoid abrasive scrubs or exfoliating tools.

Avoid introducing strong new skincare products immediately before treatment.

Do not pick, squeeze, or manipulate active blemishes or irritated areas.

If your skin becomes irritated before your appointment, contact us before proceeding with treatment.

## 5–7 DAYS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid treatments that may compromise or significantly irritate the skin, including:

Chemical peels

Microneedling

Dermaplaning

Aggressive facials

Strong exfoliation

Laser treatments on the same area

Other resurfacing treatments

Your skin should be in a healthy condition before treatment.

## 48–72 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Avoid excessive sun exposure.

Avoid tanning beds.

Avoid excessive alcohol consumption.

Avoid recreational drugs.

Avoid harsh exfoliating products.

Avoid products that cause significant redness, burning, or peeling.

Keep your skin clean and moisturized.

If you use prescription skincare or medications that may affect your skin's sensitivity or healing, please disclose this before treatment.

Do not stop prescribed medication without consulting your healthcare provider.

## 24 HOURS BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Drink plenty of water.

Get adequate rest.

Avoid excessive alcohol.

Avoid unnecessary sun exposure.

Do not pick, squeeze, or irritate the treatment area.

Keep your skincare routine gentle.

## ON THE DAY OF YOUR APPOINTMENT

Please arrive with clean skin.

For facial treatments:

Remove makeup before your appointment.

Avoid heavy creams, oils, and serums immediately before treatment.

Avoid strong active skincare products.

Do not pick or squeeze blemishes.

For body treatments, ensure the treatment area is clean and free from heavy lotions, oils, fragrances, or other products unless otherwise instructed.

## PLEASE RESCHEDULE YOUR APPOINTMENT IF:

Treatment may need to be postponed if you have:

An active skin infection in the treatment area.

Open wounds or broken skin.

Significant irritation or inflammation.

A sunburn.

Severe dryness, cracking, or peeling.

An active rash or allergic reaction.

A significant flare-up of a skin condition.

Recently undergone another treatment that has not fully healed.

If you are unsure whether your skin is ready for treatment, contact us before your appointment.

Your skin must be in an appropriate condition for treatment.

## COLD PLASMA AFTERCARE

Cold Plasma is generally well tolerated, but your skin may experience temporary redness, warmth, sensitivity, dryness, or mild tingling following treatment.

Your skin may look slightly different immediately after treatment, but the final appearance develops over time.

## FIRST 24 HOURS

## DO:

Keep the treated area clean.

Follow the cleansing instructions provided at your appointment.

Use gentle, fragrance-free skincare.

Keep the skin appropriately moisturized.

Drink plenty of water.

Follow any personalized aftercare instructions provided by your practitioner.

## AVOID:

Touching the treatment area unnecessarily.

Picking, squeezing, or scratching the skin.

Heavy makeup immediately after treatment if the skin is irritated.

Strong active skincare products.

Retinoids/retinol.

Chemical exfoliants.

Physical scrubs.

Fragranced products if the skin is sensitive.

Excessive heat.

Saunas and steam rooms.

Hot tubs.

Intense workouts if they cause excessive sweating or irritation.

## DAYS 2–7

Your skin may continue to feel slightly sensitive or dry as it settles.

During this stage:

Keep your skincare routine gentle.

Moisturize regularly.

Avoid aggressive exfoliation.

Avoid picking or manipulating the skin.

Avoid introducing new active products.

Protect your skin from excessive sun exposure.

If your skin is completely comfortable and your practitioner has advised that it is appropriate, you may gradually return to your normal skincare routine.

## SUN PROTECTION

Protecting your skin from excessive sun exposure is important after treatment.

Once your skin is comfortable, use broad-spectrum SPF as appropriate for your skin and treatment area.

Avoid:

Tanning beds

Intentional tanning

Prolonged direct sun exposure

Sun exposure can contribute to pigmentation changes and may interfere with the appearance of healing skin.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

Cold Plasma results are progressive and vary from person to person.

Depending on your treatment goals, you may notice improvements in the appearance of:

Skin texture

Overall skin clarity

Congestion

Redness or inflammation

Uneven-looking skin

General skin radiance

Some clients may notice a difference after one treatment, while others may benefit from a series of treatments.

Your recommended treatment plan will depend on your skin concerns, skin condition, and individual response.

Consistency is key to achieving the best possible results.

## BETWEEN TREATMENTS

Keep your skincare routine consistent.

Protect your skin from excessive sun exposure.

Stay hydrated.

Avoid unnecessary irritation.

Do not pick or squeeze treated areas.

Follow your recommended treatment schedule.

Follow any personalized skincare recommendations provided during your appointment.

Do not perform additional aggressive treatments on the same area without professional guidance.

## IMPORTANT

Cold Plasma is a non-invasive treatment, but individual skin responses can vary.

Temporary redness, warmth, sensitivity, dryness, or mild irritation may occur.

If you experience severe pain, blistering, significant swelling, spreading redness, pus, signs of infection, or another concerning reaction , contact Aniekanvas Aesthetics promptly and seek appropriate medical attention when necessary.

Do not attempt to treat a significant reaction yourself.

Healthy skin comes first. Your results develop with time and consistency.
